calculations.name: xG model: includes/excludes
calculations.purpose: Explicit checklist of what the production-candidate FHFH xG model includes and excludes.
calculations.method: SHOT UNIVERSE: INCLUDED unblocked attempts (goal, SOG, missed); EXCLUDED blocked shots, own goals, penalty shots, shootout, 'delayed-penalty' event rows — web/lib/xg/baselineDataset.ts:281, web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlEventInclusion.ts:106 | X,Y + RINK/SIDE NORMALIZATION: INCLUDED (mirror both x and y when team attacks left, using homeTeamDefendingSide; net at (89,0)); normalizedX/normalizedY are model inputs; EXCLUDED arena/rink-bias adjustment — web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlCoordinates.ts:51 | DISTANCE: INCLUDED, linear feet to (89,0), z-scored — web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlShotFeatureBuilder.ts:182 | ANGLE: INCLUDED, abs degrees atan2(|y|,|89-x|), z-scored; behind-net not distinguished — web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlShotFeatureBuilder.ts:192 | SHOT TYPE: INCLUDED one-hot (backhand, bat, between-legs, cradle, deflected, poke, slap, snap, tip-in, wrap-around, wrist) — web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlShotFeatureBuilder.ts:176 | REBOUND: INCLUDED boolean isReboundShot = immediately previous event is same-team SOG/missed/blocked attempt, same period, 0<dt<=3 s, no distance limit; rebound geometry/speed features EXCLUDED from production family — web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlRebounds.ts:173 | RUSH: INCLUDED boolean isRushShot = within 10 s after own takeaway/faceoff or opponent giveaway/blocked-shot in shooter's D/N zone, no intervening shot/stoppage, not a rebound, no distance/speed requirement; rush distance/speed EXCLUDED from production — web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlRush.ts:149 | FLURRY: INCLUDED boolean isFlurryShot (future-dependent); flurry-adjusted xG applied only in aggregates — web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlFlurries.ts:137, web/lib/xg/flurryAdjusted.ts:22 | PRIOR EVENT: INCLUDED previousEventTypeDescKey (one-hot), previousEventSameTeam, timeSincePreviousEventSeconds, distanceFromPreviousEvent; speed EXCLUDED — web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlPriorEventContext.ts:51 | MOVEMENT: INCLUDED eastWestMovementFeet, northSouthMovementFeet, crossedRoyalRoad — web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlContextualFeatures.ts:277 | STRENGTH STATE: INCLUDED one-hot strengthState (owner-relative EV/PP/SH/EN) AND strengthExact (away-v-home string, not owner-relative) — web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlStrengthState.ts:71 | EMPTY NET: INCLUDED (isEmptyNetEvent boolean; EN state does not distinguish shooting-at-empty-net vs own-goalie-pulled); EN shots are in training and scoring — web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlEventInclusion.ts:106 | GAME TIME: INCLUDED periodNumber, periodSecondsElapsed, gameSecondsElapsed (linear), isOvertimeEvent, ownerPowerPlayAgeSeconds, shooterShiftAgeSeconds — web/lib/xg/baselineDataset.ts:70 | ZONE: INCLUDED zoneCode one-hot (O/N/D) — web/lib/xg/baselineDataset.ts:170 (DEFAULT_CATEGORICAL_FEATURE_KEYS) | SCORE STATE: EXCLUDED from production first_pass_v1 (available only in expanded_v2: score diffs, ownerScoreDiffBucket, late-game flags); no score/venue adjustment of outputs — web/lib/xg/baselineDataset.ts:178 (EXPANDED_V2_NUMERIC_FEATURE_KEYS) | SHOOTER EFFECTS: EXCLUDED from model (no shooter id, handedness, position in first_pass_v1); a separate lagged residual shooter-finishing layer exists for diagnostics (n/(n+200), min 50) — web/lib/xg/residualSkill.ts:32 | GOALIE EFFECTS: EXCLUDED from model (no goalie id/catch hand); goalie only via GSAx = xGA - GA in aggregates and residual layer — web/lib/xg/aggregates.ts:618 | TRAINING SET & SEASONS: corrected candidate = season 20252026 only, chronological game split 70/15/15 (seed 42), test 17,834 shots / 1,295 goals; out-of-time multi-season split supported but not used by the approved artifact — web/scripts/output/xg-corrected-candidate/logistic_l2-s20252026-p1-st1-f1-cfg2afcf561/model-artifact.json | MODEL TYPE: in-house L2 logistic regression (logistic_l2), full-batch gradient descent 800 iters, lr 0.05, l2 0.01, z-scored numerics, 0-imputation, 65 encoded features; alternatives: logistic_unregularized/elastic_net, xgboost_js (broken probability mapping), Python LightGBM/CatBoost/XGBoost challengers offline — web/lib/xg/binaryLogistic.ts:84, web/scripts/train-nhl-xg-baseline.ts:931 | CALIBRATION: post-calibration fit on validation split only when |mean gap|>=0.02 or 10-bin max gap>=0.10; CV-chosen among raw/Platt/isotonic; corrected candidate selectedMethod = raw (no calibration applied); earlier approved leaky run used isotonic — web/lib/xg/calibration.ts:491 | VALIDATION METRICS: log loss, Brier, 10 equal-width calibration bins, slices by strength/rebound/rush; AUC NOT computed for shot_goal model — web/scripts/train-nhl-xg-baseline.ts:1459
calculations.reference_standard: Evolving-Hockey xG (XGBoost per strength, Fenwick, multi-season, AUC ~0.77-0.78 at 5v5); MoneyPuck xG (GBM, arena-adjusted, rebound/rush/speed/flurry, shooter talent adjustment); HockeyViz (Micah McCurdy, location-smoothed); NST xG (Fenwick, distance/angle/type/rebound/rush)
calculations.status: live — corrected candidate approved=true in artifact; deployed artifact chosen by env path in update-nhl-xg-shot-predictions.ts (not verifiable read-only)
red_flags: observation, not audited: no score-state, shooter or goalie terms; single-season training; linear distance/angle
isFlurryShot uses future events (leakage risk)
0-imputation of missing coordinates places shots at the crease/center ice
EN shots modeled jointly with a single boolean
approved earlier artifact (cfg9bac2706, isotonic) leaked missReasonBucket — check which artifact the deployed MODEL_ARTIFACT_PATH env points to
corrected candidate log loss 0.2434 vs base-rate ~0.260 (weak lift)
blocked-shot owner semantics may misassign rebounds/rush sources

calculations.name: xG team aggregate reconciliation (xGF/xGA symmetry) and operations alerts
calculations.purpose: Check that summed team xG for equals summed team xG against per game (and for flurry-adjusted aggregates) and raise operations alerts.
calculations.method: Group rows by model_version:feature_version:game_id; sum xg_for and xg_against (nulls -> 0); delta = |sum xGF - sum xGA|; issue if delta > tolerance 0.0001; report games checked, issues, max delta (6 dp). Alerts: coverage, feature drift, registry/prediction model parity, running leases, aggregate coverage, symmetry, flurry completeness (adjusted == total), calibration segments below confidence thresholds.
calculations.reference_standard: Accounting identity: league/game xGF = xGA
calculations.status: live — /api/v1/xg/operations
red_flags: observation, not audited: Number(x)||0 turns missing xG into 0, which can hide a missing side
observation, not audited: identity only proves both team rows exist with mirrored totals, not that per-shot xG is right; this does not cover what the xG model includes/excludes (see XG-001)

calculations.name: xG shot scoring route stage (artifact-gated)
calculations.purpose: Score stored shot feature rows with the configured xG model artifact and persist raw/calibrated probabilities and xG.
inputs: model artifact at env NHL_XG_MODEL_ARTIFACT_PATH or ?modelArtifactPath

What the model INCLUDES/EXCLUDES (x,y normalization, distance, angle, shot type, rebound/rush windows, strength, score state, shooter/goalie effects, training seasons, model type, calibration) is NOT determinable from this route; it lives in lib/xg and the artifact (other agent's slice).
calculations.reference_standard: MoneyPuck / Evolving-Hockey xG; calibration curves
calculations.status: unknown — depends on NHL_XG_MODEL_ARTIFACT_PATH being configured; not in vercel.json crons
red_flags: observation, not audited: allowUnapproved=true lets an unapproved artifact write production predictions (flagged in response only)

calculations.name: Platt and isotonic calibrators
calculations.purpose: Map raw probabilities to calibrated probabilities.
calculations.method: Platt: in-house logistic on logit(p) (400 iters, lr 0.05, l2 0.001), needs >=10 rows and both classes. Isotonic: pool-adjacent-violators on predictions sorted ascending, blocks store max prediction & mean label; predict = first block whose maxPrediction >= p (step function, no interpolation); above last block -> last block mean.
calculations.reference_standard: sklearn CalibratedClassifierCV / IsotonicRegression
calculations.status: live (offline) — run manually via `tsx web/scripts/train-nhl-xg-baseline.ts`; produced artifacts consumed by update-nhl-xg-shot-predictions via artifact path env; applied at scoring when artifact.calibration.applied
red_flags: isotonic blocks can return exactly 0 or 1 (clipped to 1e-9) for extreme bins
Platt via GD may be unconverged

calculations.name: Calibration requirement and cross-validated method selection
calculations.purpose: Decide whether post-calibration is needed and pick raw/Platt/isotonic.
calculations.method: Requires post-calibration if |mean pred - goal rate| >= 0.02 or any 10-equal-width-bin gap >= 0.10 (bins with >=5 rows). Folds = min(5, max(2, positives)), stratified round-robin by sorted rowId. Compare raw vs CV Platt vs CV isotonic by log loss then Brier. Calibrator fit on VALIDATION split only, then applied to all splits.
calculations.reference_standard: Platt scaling / isotonic regression (Niculescu-Mizil & Caruana); MoneyPuck/EH report calibration plots
calculations.status: live (offline) — run manually via `tsx web/scripts/train-nhl-xg-baseline.ts`; produced artifacts consumed by update-nhl-xg-shot-predictions via artifact path env
red_flags: tolerance 0.02 absolute on a ~0.07 base rate is ~30% relative — loose
equal-width [0,1] bins: ~78% of test shots fall in bin 0 in corrected candidate, so the max-gap check is nearly blind
holdout metrics later reported over validation+test although calibrator was fit on validation (optimistic)
corrected candidate selected 'raw'

calculations.name: xG post-calibration selection on validation split
calculations.purpose: Choose and apply a probability calibrator to raw xG outputs
calculations.method: skip (raw) if <10 validation examples or one class missing; else lib/xg/calibration assessCalibration decides requiresPostCalibration/adoptableMethod and fitProbabilityCalibrator fits on validation only, applied to all splits
calculations.reference_standard: Platt / isotonic calibration on held-out data
calculations.status: live — corrected candidate selected raw, approval run selected isotonic
red_flags: observation, not audited: the calibrated predictions are then evaluated on the same validation split used to fit the calibrator (validation metrics optimistic)

calculations.name: xG offline challengers (LightGBM / CatBoost / XGBoost) with Platt calibration
calculations.purpose: Benchmark gradient-boosted xG challengers against the frozen logistic baseline
source_tables: file: challenger dataset .json.gz exported by train-nhl-xg-baseline.ts
calculations.method: LightGBM 200 trees lr 0.05 leaves 31 min_child 50 subsample/colsample 0.9 lambda 1; CatBoost depth 6 lr 0.05 l2_leaf 3; XGBoost depth 4 min_child_weight 5 lr 0.05 hist; seed 42+familyIndex; Platt = logistic on logit(p) with C=1e6, needs >=20 val rows and >=10 of each class; also per-strength-state models if train>=1000 rows and >=25 pos/neg; metrics Brier, log loss, AUC, ECE with 10 equal-width bins; probs clipped 1e-7
outputs: challenger report JSON (per family global + per-state metrics, importances)
calculations.reference_standard: MoneyPuck GBM xG; Platt scaling; ECE
calculations.status: draft — offline research (training set = frozen 20252026 dataset export)
red_flags: observation, not audited: per-state models are compared on test after using only validation for calibration, but per-state test merges into 'partitioned' with global fallback, mixing two model types in one metric

calculations.name: xG evaluation metrics: log loss, Brier, calibration bins, slice evaluation
calculations.purpose: Score xG model quality per split and per slice
calculations.method: logLoss = mean(-ln p | y=1, -ln(1-p) | y=0) without clipping; Brier = mean((p-y)^2); 10 equal-width probability bins with avgPrediction & observedGoalRate; base-rate baselines: LL0 = -(r ln r + (1-r) ln(1-r)), Brier0 = r(1-r); slices by strength state, rebound, rush; metrics rounded
calculations.reference_standard: standard proper scoring rules
calculations.status: live — computed on every training run
red_flags: observation, not audited: log loss unclipped (contrast: rebound-heads script clips 1e-9, Python challengers clip 1e-7) so the three xG evaluators can disagree

calculations.name: Shot map coordinate folding, hexbin and density heatmap
calculations.purpose: Client-side transforms for team shot visualizations.
calculations.method: ShotVisualization: team shots -> (tx,ty) = (-y, -|x|) (fold by sign of x), opponent shots mirrored to top; SVG offset (+42.5,+100); d3 hexbin counts; shooting% = goals/(goals+SOG)*100. Heatmap: x+100, y+42.5, d3.contourDensity bandwidth 2.3, turbo color scale.
calculations.reference_standard: HockeyViz shot maps (attack-direction normalized via period/side)
calculations.status: live — team stats page
red_flags: folds by sign of x instead of using homeTeamDefendingSide — defensive-zone shots get plotted in the offensive zone
when x is folded, y is not negated, so left/right is swapped for mirrored shots (pure reflection, not 180-degree rotation)
Heatmap comment says 'height is 58 units' while code uses 85

calculations.name: Power-play age and shift-fatigue features
calculations.purpose: Seconds into current PP and shift ages/gaps for shooter and on-ice units.
calculations.method: Shift age = eventSec - shiftStart (prefers interval ending exactly at event second); prev gap = currentStart - prevEnd (same period only); owner/opponent average & max over on-ice players. PP age = eventTime - first observed event time while team state is PP with same strengthExact.
consumers: production model numeric features ownerPowerPlayAgeSeconds, shooterShiftAgeSeconds
calculations.reference_standard: MoneyPuck shooter time on ice / PP time elapsed
calculations.status: live — feeds nhl_xg_shot_features via admin/cron-bearer route web/pages/api/v1/db/update-nhl-xg-shot-features.ts (no schedule in vercel.json; docs/player-projections/model-inventory.json:1114 says status production)
red_flags: PP age starts at the first EVENT observed in PP state, not the penalty start, so it is understated
PP segment resets if strengthExact changes (5v4 -> 5v3) and EN state
at shift-change second the outgoing player's interval is preferred

calculations.name: East-west / north-south movement and royal-road crossing
calculations.purpose: Pre-shot puck movement proxies from the previous same-team event.
calculations.method: Only when previous event is same team: eastWest = |dY|; northSouth = curX - prevX; crossedRoyalRoad = both x >= 25 ft and sign(prevY) != sign(curY) (both nonzero).
calculations.reference_standard: MoneyPuck east-west/north-south movement; royal-road passes (tracking-based in the community)
calculations.status: live — feeds nhl_xg_shot_features via admin/cron-bearer route web/pages/api/v1/db/update-nhl-xg-shot-features.ts (no schedule in vercel.json; docs/player-projections/model-inventory.json:1114 says status production)
red_flags: x>=25 threshold sits outside the blue line (~25 ft from center) — loose 'offensive' filter
previous event is any event (hit, faceoff), not a pass

calculations.name: Shot coordinate normalization to attacking direction
calculations.purpose: Mirror raw NHL x,y so every shot attacks the net at (+89,0).
calculations.method: attackingSide = home: opposite of homeTeamDefendingSide; away: = homeTeamDefendingSide. If attacking 'left', normalizedX=-x and normalizedY=-y (180-degree rotation), else unchanged. Net fixed at x=89 ft, y=0. No rink/arena bias adjustment.
calculations.reference_standard: MoneyPuck arena-adjusted coordinates; Evolving-Hockey/HockeyViz coordinate flipping by period/home side
calculations.input_units: feet (NHL rink coords x in [-100,100], y in [-42.5,42.5])
calculations.status: live — feeds nhl_xg_shot_features via admin/cron-bearer route web/pages/api/v1/db/update-nhl-xg-shot-features.ts (no schedule in vercel.json; docs/player-projections/model-inventory.json:1114 says status production)
red_flags: observation, not audited: owner side is NHL eventOwnerTeamId; for blocked-shot events the NHL API owner is believed to be the blocking team, which would mirror blocked-shot coords/strength to the wrong team (no flip found in nhlPlayByPlayParser.ts:362)
observation, not audited: null homeTeamDefendingSide yields null coords (later imputed as 0 in model encoding)
no arena/rink-bias correction (MoneyPuck adjusts)

calculations.name: Event inclusion / empty-net / OT / rare-manpower flags
calculations.purpose: Decide which events enter shot features and tag special situations.
calculations.method: Exclude shootout (period SO or text) and penalty shots (regex /penalty[- ]shot/) from parity and shot features; also exclude event type 'delayed-penalty' from shot features. isEmptyNetEvent = strength_state=='EN'. isOvertimeEvent = period>3 or /ot/ text. hasRareManpower = strengthExact not in {3v3,4v3,3v4,4v4,5v3,3v5,5v4,4v5,5v5,6v5,5v6}.
calculations.reference_standard: MoneyPuck/EH exclude shootouts; penalty shots usually excluded or modeled separately
calculations.status: live — feeds nhl_xg_shot_features via admin/cron-bearer route web/pages/api/v1/db/update-nhl-xg-shot-features.ts (no schedule in vercel.json; docs/player-projections/model-inventory.json:1114 says status production)
red_flags: empty-net shots stay in the xG training/scoring set (flag only)
isOvertimeEvent uses period>3 so playoff OT periods all OT (fine) but regex /ot/ could match unexpected period_type text

calculations.name: Missed-shot reason buckets
calculations.purpose: Classify missed-shot reasons (wide, post, short-side...).
calculations.method: Lowercased substring match in order: short->short-side, wide, crossbar, post, over->over-net, blocked->blocked-like, else other; null -> unknown. Only for missed-shot events.
calculations.status: live — feeds nhl_xg_shot_features via admin/cron-bearer route web/pages/api/v1/db/update-nhl-xg-shot-features.ts (no schedule in vercel.json; docs/player-projections/model-inventory.json:1114 says status production)
red_flags: post-shot outcome information; was used as a model feature in the approved run cfg9bac2706 (log loss 0.142, implausibly good) and is now on FORBIDDEN_BASELINE_FEATURE_INPUT_KEYS (baselineDataset.ts:241); still present in NUMERIC/BOOLEAN/CATEGORICAL key lists

calculations.name: Prior-event context (time, distance, speed from previous event)
calculations.purpose: Describe the event immediately preceding each shot.
calculations.method: previousEventSameTeam = owner ids equal; distanceFromPreviousEvent = Euclidean distance on RAW coords; speed = distance/seconds if seconds>0 else null; also normalized coords of both events.
consumers: xG features (first_pass_v1 uses previousEventTypeDescKey, previousEventSameTeam, time, distance)
calculations.reference_standard: MoneyPuck 'time since last event', 'distance from last event', 'speed from last event'
calculations.status: live — feeds nhl_xg_shot_features via admin/cron-bearer route web/pages/api/v1/db/update-nhl-xg-shot-features.ts (no schedule in vercel.json; docs/player-projections/model-inventory.json:1114 says status production)
red_flags: distance uses raw coords across events whose owners differ; OK within one period but blocked-shot owner semantics leak in
speed null when 0-second gap (common)

calculations.name: Rebound-control outcome labels (creates rebound / goalie freeze / no-danger)
calculations.purpose: Label each source shot by what happened next (training label for rebound_creation model).
calculations.method: If a rebound shot followed -> second_chance_allowed (confidence high); else if source is SOG and next event is 'stoppage' within 3 s same period -> goalie_freeze + covered_puck (medium); otherwise no_danger_continuation (medium).
calculations.reference_standard: MoneyPuck expected rebounds / rebound control
calculations.status: live — feeds nhl_xg_shot_features via admin/cron-bearer route web/pages/api/v1/db/update-nhl-xg-shot-features.ts (no schedule in vercel.json; docs/player-projections/model-inventory.json:1114 says status production)
red_flags: any stoppage within 3 s after a SOG is treated as goalie freeze (could be puck out of play, net off)
goal events as sources are excluded (REBOUND_SOURCE_TYPES lacks goal) — fine

calculations.name: Rebound shot definition and rebound geometry
calculations.purpose: Flag shots that follow a same-team shot attempt within 3 s and measure displacement.
calculations.method: isReboundShot = immediately previous event (no intervening events allowed) is an eligible SOG/missed/blocked attempt by the SAME owner team, same period, and 0 < dt <= 3 s. Geometry: lateral displacement |dY|, distance delta (cur-src), angle change |dAngle|, distance from source (raw), speed = dist/dt.
calculations.reference_standard: MoneyPuck rebound = shot within 3 s of prior shot; Evolving-Hockey rebound <=2-3 s
calculations.status: live — feeds nhl_xg_shot_features via admin/cron-bearer route web/pages/api/v1/db/update-nhl-xg-shot-features.ts (no schedule in vercel.json; docs/player-projections/model-inventory.json:1114 says status production)
red_flags: strict dt>0 excludes same-second rebounds (1-s clock resolution) — likely undercounts rebounds vs MoneyPuck
requires same owner team: if NHL blocked-shot owner is the blocker, rebounds after blocked shots are never flagged
only the immediately previous event is checked; any intervening event (e.g., hit, giveaway) breaks it

calculations.name: Rush shot definition
calculations.purpose: Flag non-rebound shots preceded within 10 s by a qualifying turnover/faceoff/block in the shooting team's D or N zone.
calculations.method: Scan backward up to 10 s (same period, dt>0). Qualifying sources: own takeaway, own faceoff win, opponent giveaway, opponent-owned blocked-shot. Source zone converted to shooting-team-relative (invert O/D for opponent events); rush if relative zone is D or N. Break on stoppage/penalty/period events, any other shot, opponent takeaway/faceoff, own giveaway. Rebound shots are never rush. Distance from source uses raw coords.
calculations.reference_standard: MoneyPuck rush = within 4 s of an event in neutral/defensive zone; Evolving-Hockey ~ similar
calculations.status: live — feeds nhl_xg_shot_features via admin/cron-bearer route web/pages/api/v1/db/update-nhl-xg-shot-features.ts (no schedule in vercel.json; docs/player-projections/model-inventory.json:1114 says status production)
red_flags: 10 s window is much wider than MoneyPuck's 4 s and has no speed/distance requirement
'opponent-owned blocked-shot' as rush source depends on NHL owner semantics for blocked shots (unverified)
faceoff win in D/N zone counts as rush source

calculations.name: Score state context
calculations.purpose: Score before event, owner-relative differential and late-game buckets.
calculations.method: Running score updated after each event (max of carried score fields). ownerDiff bucket: <=-2 trail-2plus, -1, 0 tied, +1, >=+2 lead-2plus. Segments: <20 min early, <40 mid, <55 late, else final-five; OT/SO separate. Late-game window >=50:00; isLateGameClose |diff|<=1; final five >=55:00, final two >=58:00 (REG only).
consumers: expanded_v2 model features (not in production first_pass_v1)
calculations.reference_standard: Score-and-venue adjustment (Tulsky/Micah McCurdy HockeyViz/EH score-adjusted xG)
calculations.status: live — feeds nhl_xg_shot_features via admin/cron-bearer route web/pages/api/v1/db/update-nhl-xg-shot-features.ts (no schedule in vercel.json; docs/player-projections/model-inventory.json:1114 says status production)
red_flags: production first_pass_v1 model has NO score-state feature
no score/venue adjustment applied to aggregates (unadjusted_observed per hardeningAudit.ts)

calculations.name: Shift stints and on-ice attribution
calculations.purpose: Turn shift rows into constant-personnel stints and resolve on-ice players at event time.
calculations.method: Fix end<=start using duration; split each period at all shift boundaries; merge adjacent identical stints. Event at a boundary second resolves to the stint ENDING at that second (outgoing players) first.
calculations.reference_standard: NST/EH on-ice attribution at shift changes (NST credits players on ice at event time; conventions differ on change seconds)

calculations.name: Goalie-on-ice flags and shot outcome flags
calculations.purpose: Derive goalie presence and goal/SOG/unblocked/own-goal flags; normalize shot type.
calculations.method: ownerGoalieOnIce = owner-side goalie digit > 0; isUnblockedShotAttempt = type != blocked-shot and not own goal (goal, SOG, missed). shotType lowercased/trimmed (11 levels incl. bat, between-legs, cradle, poke).

calculations.name: Shot distance and angle
calculations.purpose: Euclidean distance (ft) and absolute angle (deg) from normalized shot location to net.
calculations.method: distance = sqrt((89-x)^2 + (0-y)^2); angle = atan2(|y|,|89-x|)*180/pi (0 = straight on, 90 = goal line). Shots from behind the net (x>89) get the same angle as mirrored front shots because abs(89-x) is used.
calculations.reference_standard: MoneyPuck/Evolving-Hockey shot distance & angle (EH uses signed/abs angle, behind-net handled separately)
calculations.status: live — feeds nhl_xg_shot_features via admin/cron-bearer route web/pages/api/v1/db/update-nhl-xg-shot-features.ts (no schedule in vercel.json; docs/player-projections/model-inventory.json:1114 says status production)
red_flags: behind-the-net shots indistinguishable from in-front shots by angle (abs on deltaX)
logic duplicated in 3 files (nhlShotFeatureBuilder, nhlRebounds, reboundRichLabels)
model uses raw linear distance/angle (no log/spline), see model entry

calculations.name: Game-clock hydration and seconds-since-previous-event
calculations.purpose: Derive period duration, cumulative game seconds and inter-event gaps.
calculations.method: periodDuration = elapsed+remaining, else 1200 s regulation / 300 s OT (regular-season OT assumption); game_seconds = sum of prior period durations + period elapsed; seconds_since_previous_event = max(0, gameSec - prevGameSec). Events sorted by sort_order then event_id.

calculations.name: xG model specification as trained (includes / excludes)
calculations.purpose: Record exactly what the in-house shot xG model uses, per the trainer defaults and saved artifacts

MODEL TYPE: default CLI family xgboost_js, but saved candidates are logistic_l2 (800 iters, lr 0.05, l2 0.01, train-only z-scored numerics, one-hot categoricals). CALIBRATION: validation-fit post-calibration chosen by lib/xg/calibration (corrected candidate: raw; approval run: isotonic)

consumers: xG shot scoring, NST-parity metrics, rebound heads, CTPI/team ratings via xG columns (other slices)

calculations.name: Binary logistic regression trainer (in-house gradient descent)
calculations.purpose: Fit the production shot-goal model (logistic_l2) and calibrators.
calculations.method: Full-batch gradient descent from zero weights/bias: grad = sum(error*x*w)/totalWeight; update w -= lr*(grad + l1*sign(w) + l2*w); bias unpenalized. Defaults: 800 iterations, lr 0.05. Families: logistic_unregularized (l1=0,l2=0), logistic_l2 (l2=0.01), logistic_elastic_net (l1=0.001,l2=0.01). Output clipped to [1e-9, 1-1e-9]. No convergence check.
calculations.reference_standard: scikit-learn LogisticRegression (lbfgs, converged); Evolving-Hockey/MoneyPuck use gradient boosting (XGBoost/GBM)

calculations.purpose: Alternative tree model; CLI default family.

calculations.name: xG-adjusted player impact (shot-level ridge, 'RAPM-like')
calculations.purpose: Estimate one coefficient per skater for on-ice xG differential with teammate/opponent and context controls.
inputs: on-ice skaters from shift stint at event time
strength, score diff, period seconds, zone, rest days
calculations.method: One design row PER SHOT (no rows for shot-free time). Response = shot xG (response_xg_differential = xg, always >=0). Shooting-team skaters coded +1, opponents -1 (goalies removed), single coefficient per player (offense and defense pooled). Context: is_home +/-1, period_seconds/1200, owner score diff, rest-day diff, one-hot strength_state, strength_exact, score bucket, zone_code, shot_zone_code. Fit: full-batch GD on squared error, intercept init = mean response, 500 iterations, lr 0.03, L2 0.1 on player and context weights; minPlayerRows=100 (route default). SE approx = sqrt(MSE / player rows).

calculations.name: Lagged residual shooter/goalie skill layer
calculations.purpose: Adjust baseline xG with shrunken prior-to-date shooter finishing and goalie save residuals.

calculations.name: Shot-assist candidates / expected primary assists
calculations.purpose: Heuristic credit of shot xG to the prior same-team event actor.
calculations.method: Eligible: unblocked, non-rebound shot; previous event same team, 0<dt<=8 s, previous type not in excluded set (faceoff, shots, goal, giveaway, stoppage, penalties, period events...) -> effectively takeaways and hits. confidence = 0.35 +0.25 (dt<=3) or +0.15 (dt<=5) +0.15 (dist<=35) or +0.05 (dist<=70) +0.10 (entered OZ) +0.05 (regained) -0.20 (hit), clamped [0.1,0.85]; tiers >=0.7 high, >=0.45 medium. expected_primary_assists = xg * confidence.
calculations.reference_standard: Tracked passing data (Corey Sznajder/AllThreeZones), MoneyPuck/EH xA

calculations.name: Transition proxies (controlled entry/exit, transition-created xG)

calculations.method: Transition shot = unblocked non-rebound shot that is a rush, or possession entered OZ with possession duration <=15 s. Source = rush source, else possession start, else previous event; faceoff sources skipped. Shooter gets transition_created_shot with confidence 0.7 (rush) / 0.5, minus 0.15 if source zone not D/N; actor gets controlled_entry_proxy (0.7/0.5) when source zone N/D and same team; controlled_exit_proxy (0.65/0.45) when source zone D; dump_in 0.3 if type contains 'dump'. transition_created_xg = xg * confidence.

calculations.method: Scope: horizons must be contiguous 1..k with k <= 10. Categories must be valid and include every non-zero DEFAULT_SCORING category. The default profile, participationQualified, and interval levels 0.5 and 0.9 are required, as is a hashed joint generator. Scope is full_v2 iff 10 horizons and all 7 categories, else contiguous_subset. Vintage must be public_serving, share target/conditioning/model/feature/code versions with the manifest, have a supported horizon and cohort, and use scoring rule 'linear-seven-v1'. Every contributing category must be available. Four evidence records must have matching hashes and scope digest, be approved, passed and independent with author != reviewer, and be in chronological order. The final evaluation must be untouched, with a sample manifest different from the prospective one, and review issued after both evaluations. qualifiedMeans masks unqualified categories; participation must be a finite value in [0,1].

calculations.sub_family: FORGE projections / FORGE v2 pipeline stage (scheduling)

calculations.method: lock = min(scheduled start, accepted lock). Daily job: deadline = min(08:00 America/New_York, found DST-safely as 12:00 or 13:00 UTC, lock), ready = min(now, deadline). Pregame: ready = deadline = min(start − 30 min, lock). Material event: ready = min(received + 5 min, deadline, lock − 1 ms), deadline = min(received + 15 min, lock). Pending unissued material jobs for the same target are coalesced, taking the minimum of lock/deadline/ready (≤1000 events). Scopes are capped at 100,000. Claim slots = min(batchSize, concurrency − running). A horizon episode number increments when a player-game re-enters the same horizon; episodes close when the horizon changes.

calculations.purpose: Convert American odds to implied probability and remove margin

Yes-only: estimate = implied - overround/2 (default 0.08, env FORGE_YES_ONLY_OVERROUND, max 0.3). EV = p*(decimal-1) - (1-p).

calculations.reference_standard: Published B2B effects (~-0.1 to -0.2 goals/team-game)
calculations.status: live (legacy bucket mode)
red_flags: observation: production passes buckets:'legacy', which per the code comment is 'for offline backtests only'; in legacy a B2B (rest 1) is read as 2 (mild fatigue 0.035 not 0.11)
observation: TOI multiplier and shot multiplier are both renormalised away by team reconciliation

calculations.name: Small-sample shrinkage weight
calculations.purpose: Evidence weight used to shrink TOI and goal conversion toward priors for thin samples
calculations.method: toiW = T/(T+900) with T = ev+pp TOI (SKATER_SMALL_SAMPLE_TOI_SECONDS_SCALE=900); shotW = S/(S+45); sampleWeight = 0.58*toiW + 0.42*shotW. isLowSample <0.45, callup fallback <0.22. Shrunk TOI = w*adjustedTOI + (1-w)*season avg TOI; goal rate = w*splitRate + (1-w)*F/D prior.
calculations.reference_standard: Tango regression to the mean (k = exposure where reliability = 0.5)
calculations.status: live
red_flags: observation: TOI evidence uses toi_seconds_avg_all (a per-game AVERAGE, ~800-1200 s) against a 900 s scale, so toiW is ~0.5 for nearly every player regardless of games played (likely unit mismatch: average vs cumulative)
observation: goal rate is shrunk twice (prior-strength k in blendOnlineRate, then this weight) — acknowledged in comment at skater-stage.ts:2292

calculations.name: Hits and blocks per 60 (physical rates)
calculations.purpose: All-situation hits/blocks per 60 blended recent vs three-season baseline shrunk to position prior with league rescale
inputs: league totals to date and prior two seasons
calculations.method: Position priors: F hits 4.9, blocks 2.1; D hits 3.2, blocks 4.4 per 60. League per60 = (60*events + prior60*S)/(minutes + S), S=9000 (F)/5750 (D) minutes; scale = clamp(per60/prior60,0.7,1.3). Baseline = (seasonEvents + 0.5*scale*(events3y - seasonEvents))*60 + priorMin*ref) / (seasonMin + 0.5*(min3y-seasonMin) + priorMin), priorMin hits 50 / blocks 300. Recent weight = m5/(m5+240) hits, m5/(m5+1000) blocks. Projected = rate x (ES+PP TOI x clamp(allTOI5/esPpTOI,1,1.3))/3600.
calculations.reference_standard: Marcel-style weighting; Poisson deviance fit (code comment)
calculations.status: live
red_flags: observation: PK time is not projected; physical TOI uses ES+PP x recent all-situation ratio capped 1.3
observation: hit/block counts are rink-scorer dependent; no venue adjustment here (fantasy-projections evaluator has venue multipliers)

calculations.name: Assist share and team assist allocation
calculations.purpose: Assists = on-ice team goals x assist share, scaled so team assists per goal match league
calculations.method: onIceGoalsHist = (G+A)/(IPP/100); share = (A + k*prior)/(onIceGoals + k): F es 0.3747 k=258, F pp 0.3554 k=58, D es 0.2782 k=309, D pp 0.4838 k=84; clamp 0.02-0.9; x trend and teammate coupling multipliers. Team goals = sum(shots x goalRate). onIce_i = teamGoals*5*toi_i/teamToi. raw = sum(onIce*share); scale = 1.65 (ES) or 1.91 (PP) x teamGoals / raw; assists_i = onIce_i*share_i*scale.
calculations.reference_standard: IPP / on-ice point shares; NHL ~1.7 assists per goal
calculations.status: live
red_flags: observation: IPP assumed to be a percent (0-100); a fraction-stored IPP would inflate onIceGoals 100x
observation: team scale cancels any uniform multiplier, so team-level/opp-goalie/rest assist multipliers (passed as assistRateMultiplier) have no effect on lineup assists
observation: computeStrengthSplitConversionRates still computes assist-per-goal rates that are unused by the lineup path

calculations.name: Skater shot rate per 60 (shrunk)
calculations.purpose: Per-strength shots on goal per 60 shrunk to F/D priors by measured hours
calculations.method: Priors (2023-24..2025-26 NST logs, k from split halves): F es 6.62/60 k=8.4 h, F pp 11.23 k=10.3 h; D es 4.11 k=12.3 h, D pp 8.39 k=5 h. hoursAll = shotsAll/ratePer60All. base = (shotsAll + k*prior)/(hoursAll + k). Recent: w = h5/(h5+k); rate = base + w*(shots5/h5 - base). Then x product of shot-quality, on-ice, team-level and rest multipliers; clamp ES 1.5-20, PP 2-28; role bounds. Shots = rate/60 * TOI minutes.
calculations.reference_standard: Tango regression to mean; NST per-60 convention
calculations.input_units: shots counts; per-60 rates; TOI seconds
calculations.status: live
red_flags: observation: last-5 games are inside the all-window and are blended in again (double counting recent games)
observation: hoursAll is implied from shots/rate, undefined when shots=0 (falls back to prior only)

calculations.name: Goal conversion (goals per shot) by strength
calculations.purpose: Shrunk ES/PP goals-per-shot with recent blend and context multipliers
calculations.method: Priors: F es 0.1181 k=423 shots, F pp 0.1589 k=155; D es 0.0537 k=704, D pp 0.0862 k=73. base=(goalsAll+k*prior)/(shotsAll+k); recent weight = shots5/(shots5+k); blended clamp ES 0.025-0.24, PP 0.04-0.36; x (shotQuality x onIce x teamLevel x oppGoalie x rest) goal multipliers, clamp ES 0.02-0.3 PP 0.03-0.45. Then skater-stage re-shrinks: rate = w*rate + (1-w)*prior (w = sample weight), clamp ES 0.025-0.3 PP 0.04-0.45, x trend multiplier. Goals = shots x rate.
calculations.reference_standard: Tango regression to mean; shooting% reliability (~375-400 shots for forwards)
calculations.status: live
red_flags: observation: recent last-5 shots counted in both base and recent blend
observation: up to five multiplicative context goal multipliers compound (code notes ~1.3 for some skaters)
observation: second shrink with a weight that is ~0.5 for everyone (see small-sample entry)

calculations.name: Shot-quality adjustment
calculations.purpose: Shot-rate and goal-rate multipliers from ixG per shot and rush+rebound rates
calculations.method: qualityPerShot = ixG60/shots60; sampleWeight = shots60/(shots60+5); qualityEdge = clamp((q-0.09)/0.09, ±0.35); rushReboundEdge = clamp((rush60+reb60-1.1)/1.1, ±0.5). shot mult = clamp(1+w*(0.05*qE+0.08*rrE), 0.82,1.2); goal mult = clamp(1+w*(0.26*qE+0.07*rrE), 0.78,1.3).
calculations.reference_standard: MoneyPuck/Evolving-Hockey ixG per shot
calculations.status: live
red_flags: observation: profile is the single latest player_stats_unified row (one game's per-60 values, comment 'per-game actuals'), so the multiplier is driven by one game
observation: sampleWeight uses a per-60 rate as if it were a sample size
observation: baseline 0.09 ixG/shot not position-specific

calculations.name: Research goal kernels and skater-candidate accounting (offline)
calculations.purpose: Offline research estimators for per-appearance goals, appearance probabilities, priors and context ablation
calculations.method: Goal cells (24 disjoint REG/OT x net-state x skater-state); smoothed appearance p = (n+0.5)/(N+1); conditional means shrink with 1 pseudo-appearance to population; logit-shift calibration so sum p = expected roster count (bisection ±40); own/opponent blend 0.5/0.5. Split-half k fit minimising RMSE. shrinkRate = (events + mean*k)/(exposure + k). Capped proportional assist allocation with capacity = onIceGoals - goals. opportunity moments var = mean + r^2 Var(T).
calculations.reference_standard: Empirical Bayes; split-half reliability
calculations.status: draft — offline research only

calculations.name: Availability multiplier from roster events
calculations.purpose: Convert injury/scratch/benching events to a production multiplier
calculations.method: OUT/IR/LTIR/SUSPENSION/NON_ROSTER/SENDDOWN -> 0; DTD -> clamp(1-0.6c,0.2,1); BENCHING -> clamp(1-0.45c,0.35,1); SCRATCH -> clamp(1-0.8c,0.05,1); RETURN/CALLUP -> 1. Confidence default clamp(conf ?? 0.75, 0.5, 1). When STARTER_BOARD_COMPUTE_ENABLED, multiplier collapses to 0/1 (production conditional on playing).
calculations.status: live (behaviour depends on STARTER_BOARD_COMPUTE_ENABLED / START_CHART_GAME_REVISIONS)

calculations.name: Teammate assist coupling
calculations.purpose: Assist-share multiplier from linemate shot share and PP share
calculations.method: playerShare=clamp(ps/team,0,0.5); lineShare=clamp(group/team,0,0.85); mateShare=clamp(line-player,0,0.75); tierW TOP 1, MIDDLE 0.72, else 0.48; lineDep=clamp(1.65*mate*tierW,0,0.5); ppDep=clamp(ppShare*(0.9+0.35tierW),0,0.65); ES mult=clamp(1+0.62(lineDep-0.14),0.82,1.2); PP mult=clamp(1+0.75(ppDep-0.18),0.8,1.24).
calculations.status: live

calculations.name: Skater role scenarios and horizon scenario blend
calculations.purpose: Mixture of current/adjacent/depth role scenarios that scales goals and assists
calculations.method: P(current)=clamp(0.55+0.3*share-0.2*vol,0.45,0.9); P(adjacent)=clamp(0.28-0.12*share+0.18*vol,0.08,0.42); P(depth)=clamp(1-cur-adj,0.03,0.25); merge duplicates, normalise. Scenario multiplier: same family delta=currentRank-scenarioRank: goal=clamp(1+0.07*delta,0.82,1.2), assist=clamp(1+0.09*delta,0.8,1.24); cross-family 0.97. Per horizon game, reversion toward uniform = clamp(0.18*i + 0.12*vol, 0, 0.75). Blended stat = sum over games and scenarios of (scalar/sumScalars)*p*base*mult. Used only when FORGE_SKATER_MODEL_MODE=candidate; baseline mode keeps base lines (scenario mixture also feeds uncertainty only in candidate).
calculations.status: flagged off — FORGE_SKATER_MODEL_MODE must equal 'candidate' (skaterRollout.ts:12); default 'baseline'

calculations.name: Skater recency multiplier and active-pool filter
calculations.purpose: Down-weight or drop skaters whose latest metric is stale, measured in regular-season days
calculations.method: Regular-season days between last game and cutoff (only days inside regular-season intervals count). <=21 days ->1; >45 -> 0 (excluded); linear between to minimum 0.15. Multiplies TOI and shots. Pool target 18, min valid 15, supplemental fetch 24; emergency inclusion when <15.
calculations.status: live

calculations.name: Sustainability trend-band adjustment
calculations.purpose: Shot/goal/assist multipliers and uncertainty widening from a player's sustainability trend band
calculations.method: Pick freshest row by metric priority fantasy_score > ixg_per_60 > shots_per_60 > points_per_60_5v5. signedDistance = (value-upper)/width if above, -(lower-value)/width if below, else 0; clamp ±2. nEffWeight = clamp(n_eff/8,0.35,1) (0.6 if null); recency = 1 if age<=3 days, 0 if >=21, linear between. signal = dist*nEffW*recency. shot mult = clamp(1+0.08s,0.88,1.12); goal = clamp(1+0.10s,0.86,1.14); assist = clamp(1+0.08s,0.88,1.12); volatility = 1+clamp(0.45|s|,0,0.55).
calculations.status: live

observation: direction: value above band increases rates (momentum, not regression)

calculations.name: Player and team game strength tables
calculations.purpose: Per-game ES/PP/PK TOI, shots (SOG+goals), goals, assists per player and team
inputs: pbp plays shot-on-goal/goal, shooter, scorer, assisters
calculations.method: Shots = shot-on-goal + goal events attributed to shootingplayerid (scorer for goals); goals to scorer; assists to assist1/assist2; split by strengthForTeam; shootout excluded. Team row = sum of player rows (skater-seconds, so ~18,000 s per game total).

calculations.name: Strength-state classification and shift strength TOI
calculations.purpose: Classify PBP events and shift seconds as ES/PP/PK from situationCode
inputs: situationCode (away goalie, away skaters, home skaters, home goalie)
calculations.method: Effective skaters = skaters - 1 if own goalie pulled; more -> pp, fewer -> pk, equal -> es (3v3/4v4/6v5 EA count as ES). Shootout = periodType SO or period >=5 in preseason/regular season. Situation timeline per period from successive PBP situation codes; each shift's seconds split by overlap with timeline segments; must cover duration exactly.

calculations.name: Team-to-player reconciliation (TOI and shots)
calculations.purpose: Force player TOI and shots to sum to team targets, with a guard against one player taking too much
calculations.method: TOI: largest-remainder integer apportionment proportional to player TOI to ES/PP targets. Shots: proportional scaling to ES target = team last-10 mean shots_es; PP target = official last-10 PP shots (else strength-table mean). If any player's ES share >0.24 or PP share >0.58, blend 60% reconciled + 40% pre-reconciliation and renormalise to targets.
calculations.reference_standard: Top-down team-total constraints
calculations.status: live

calculations.name: Role-specific usage bounds
calculations.purpose: Clamp TOI and shot rates to tier-specific ranges
calculations.method: TOP: ES 780-1500 s, PP 120-560 s, SOG/60 max ES 15 PP 21; MIDDLE: ES 560-1180, PP 40-360, max 11.5/17; DEPTH: ES 260-940, PP 0-190, max 8.2/13. SOG/60 floors 1.2 ES, 1.5 PP. PP minimum waived when no PP unit. PP role from PP_UNIT_CHANGE event bounds PP separately.

calculations.name: Team PP share and PP TOI allocation
calculations.purpose: Team PP opportunity share and its distribution across skaters
inputs: WGO per-player pp_toi, toi_per_game, pp_shots last 10 team games
calculations.method: Official: ppShare = mean PP skater-seconds / mean all-situation skater-seconds over last 10 regular-season games (min 3); team-game rows with summed TOI <3600 treated as minutes (x60). Fallback: PP/(ES+PP+PK) from strength table; legacy share PP/(ES+PP) kept for ledger. PP target = round(clamp(share,0,0.5) x team target seconds); ES target = target - PP. Allocation proportional to official last-10 PP TOI avg (else pre-allocation PP TOI), clamp 0-1400 s per player; shots PP scaled by clamp(new/old,0.25,4).

calculations.name: Team TOI target with undersized-pool guard
calculations.purpose: Team skater-seconds target (5 x 3600) capped when too few skaters are projected
calculations.method: Canonical 18,000 skater-seconds. If projected count < 15: blendedTopShare = 0.24*(1-pp)+0.58*pp; cap = max(1800, min(floor(2100/blendedTopShare), count x 1200)); target = min(18000, cap).
calculations.status: live

calculations.name: WGO TOI normalization and deployment-prior TOI blend
calculations.purpose: Convert WGO TOI fields to seconds and blend rolling TOI with WGO deployment prior
calculations.method: WGO value <=60 treated as minutes (x60), <=3600 as seconds, else capped 3600. PP prior clamp 0-1200 s, ES 0-2400 s (ES = total - PP if missing). Rolling TOI = last5 avg else all-window avg else defaults 700 s ES / 120 s PP. Blend = w*rolling + (1-w)*WGO latest-game prior, w=0.8 if rolling row exists else 0.45. Then x rest toiMultiplier, clamp ES 0-2600, PP 0-1300.
calculations.reference_standard: NST/WGO per-game TOI conventions
calculations.input_units: seconds (rolling); minutes or seconds (WGO, heuristically detected)

calculations.name: Line-combination recency, role tags and fallback ranking
calculations.purpose: Assign each skater an ES role (L1-L4, D1-D3) and unit tier from line combos, roster events or TOI rank
calculations.method: Line combo soft-stale >10 days, hard-stale >21 days (missing = hard). Forwards chunked by 3 -> L1..L4, D by 2 -> D1..D3; non-F/D positions -> L4. Tier: L1/D1 TOP, L2/D2 MIDDLE, else DEPTH. Roster event LINE_CHANGE lineNumber (default 3) clamp 1-4; PP_UNIT_CHANGE ppUnit (default 2) clamp 1-3. Fallback ranks by rolling TOI over 120-day lookback, 18 players (24 for pool recovery).

observation: L3 forwards counted DEPTH tier for usage bounds but MIDDLE_SIX bucket in accuracy (run-projection-accuracy.ts:603)

calculations.name: Role continuity and stability multiplier
calculations.purpose: Penalise or boost a skater's TOI/shots by how stable his recent role is
calculations.method: Window 10 games. continuityShare = games in current role / tracked; roleChangeRate = changes/(n-1); volatility = distinct roles/n. penalty = (0.6-share)*0.35 if share<0.6 + changeRate*0.12 + (vol-0.5)*0.2 if vol>0.5; bonus = min(0.05,(share-0.75)*0.2) if n>=4 and share>=0.75. multiplier = clamp(1-penalty+bonus, 0.7, 1.05). Multiplies TOI and shots (with recency and availability multipliers) before reconciliation.
calculations.status: live

observation: magic constants, no fit evidence

calculations.name: Count distribution helpers and fitted dispersion
calculations.purpose: NB/Poisson pmf, cdf, quantiles, over/under/push probabilities with fitted alpha(mu)
calculations.method: Var = mu + b*mu + a*mu^2; alpha(mu) = a/H + b/mu. Fitted: SOG F a=0.0012 b=0.0983 (cond a=0,b=0.0458), SOG D 0.0211/0.0345, HIT F 0.0069/0.1842, HIT D 0.0162/0.1728, BLK F 0.0952/0.0111, BLK D 0.0306/0.0547, SV G a=0.0401, SA G a=0.0291; goals and assists Poisson (negative fitted alpha). TOI compounding: a' = a(1+c^2)+c^2. pmf via log recursion truncated at tail <1e-12. Over = 1-CDF(floor(line)); push at integer lines.
calculations.reference_standard: Negative binomial NB2/NB1; log score, RPS, PIT (holdout described in comment)
calculations.status: live

observation: goalie a,b not separately identified (comment)

calculations.name: Player uncertainty Monte Carlo (p10/p50/p90)
calculations.purpose: Simulated quantiles for skater TOI, shots, goals, assists, points, PPP, hits, blocks
calculations.method: 400 samples, deterministic FNV-seeded RNG. Per game: TOI ~ Normal(mean, 10% ES / 15% PP SD), toiScale = drawn/base; shots ~ Poisson(mean*toiScale*Gamma(1/alpha)) with NB alpha from dispersion fit (TOI-conditional compounded with residual TOI CV); goals ~ Poisson(goal mean*toiScale) independent of drawn shots; assists ~ Poisson independent of goals; hits/blocks NB. Totals summed over horizon; quantiles at floor(p*(n-1)); spreads widened by trend volatility (0.75-1.8). Poisson >=30 uses rounded normal approx.
calculations.reference_standard: NB2 count models; predictive intervals
calculations.status: live (negativeBinomial:true passed from skater stage)

observation: no parameter uncertainty in rates; dispersion fit uses within-player-season variance, so bands may be too narrow
observation: p10/p90 of discrete counts with inclusive coverage scoring

calculations.purpose: Quantiles for team TOI, shots and goals

calculations.purpose: Quantiles for shots against, goals allowed and saves
calculations.method: 400 samples; scenario drawn by starter probability (plus residual mass). Shots ~ NB(alpha('sa','G')) or Poisson; GA ~ Poisson(GA mean x drawn/expected shots), or Binomial(shots, GA/SA) when jointGoalieCounts; saves = shots - GA.

calculations.name: FORGE count dispersion fit (NB2 method of moments) and holdout scoring
calculations.purpose: Fit Var = mu + a*mu^2 + b*mu overdispersion for SOG/hits/blocks/G/A/saves and score on 2025-26 holdout
inputs: per-game shots, hits, blocked_shots, goals, assists, toi_per_game
calculations.method: fit seasons 2023-24 & 2024-25, date Oct 1-Apr 30, games_played=1, player-seasons with >=20 games; within player-season moments binned by mean; unconditional nu=sum n(s^2-m), du=sum n(m^2 - s^2/n); TOI-conditional mu_g = player-season count per second * game TOI; NNLS through origin of (Var-mu) on mu^2 and mu (fallback single-term by SSE); holdout = 2025-26 games, predictive mean = player's prior up-to-40-game mean (>=10 prior games, crosses seasons), 20 ntile bins of mu by stat/pos; score with lib countPmf: mean negative log score, ranked probability score, randomized PIT 10-bin total variation
outputs: fitted a,b per stat:pos; log score, RPS, PIT flatness
tables_written: --json file only (constants then hand-copied to lib/projections/dispersion FORGE_DISPERSION)
calculations.reference_standard: negative binomial (NB2) overdispersion; RPS and PIT for count forecasts
calculations.output_scale: dispersion coefficients a (per mu^2) and b (per mu); scores

calculations.name: FORGE v2 evaluation scoring (CRPS, log score, interval score, block bootstrap)
calculations.purpose: Score frozen forecasts and summarise accountability
calculations.method: CRPS = E|X-y| - 0.5E|X-X'| via sorted pairwise sum; log score -ln P(actual) for counts; interval score = width + 2/alpha*miss; Brier, log loss, 10-bin reliability; MAE/MSE/RMSE/bias; mixture moments mean=p*mu, var=p*v+p(1-p)mu^2; SV% and GAA as ratio of expected counts; paired block bootstrap (LCG seed) 95% CI of score differences with blocks >= max target span.

calculations.purpose: Gaussian-kernel weighted means of per-appearance category counts and calibrated appearance probability
calculations.method: weight = exp(-sum(((x_i - x_ctx)/bandwidth)^2)/2); category mean = weighted mean over examples with available values; PPP capped at G+A. Recipe selected by development MSE over predeclared recipes; time-partitioned train/development/calibration. Baselines: last-5 mean and season mean. Participation: kernel-weighted appearance rate, calibrated by binning raw probabilities (binCount, minimumBinSupport) on the calibration split.

calculations.name: Rolling-origin randomized conformal 80% interval calibration
calculations.purpose: Scales per-player predictive variance so p10-p90 intervals cover 80% in validation
calculations.method: predictive variance = (support*player_var + k*max(|prior|,0.01))/(support+k); z = |y - estimate|/sqrt(max(var,0.01)); interval multiplier = ceil(0.8n)-th order statistic of z; tie probability randomizes coverage to exactly 0.8; intervalVarianceScale = (multiplier/1.281551565545)^2
calculations.reference_standard: split conformal prediction (absolute standardized residual)
calculations.output_scale: sd multiplier; variance scale; coverage fraction 0-1

calculations.name: Season roster consensus and roster_confidence ladder
calculations.purpose: Decide a player's organization and roster status from official observations (two-source agreement) and assign the roster_confidence that feeds the season projection model.
inputs: season roster observations (official_roster, player_landing, official_transaction, trusted_ifttt) with confidence, availableAt and supersedesId
calculations.method: Take the latest non-superseded observation per kind. Fewer than 2 official kinds → review_required, confidence = that single source's confidence (or 0). Distinct teams, or unsigned plus a team → review_required, confidence = max. Automatic only when roster+landing agree on a team, or landing+transaction agree (team, or both unsigned); then confidence = min of the agreeing pair, with roster status from the pair (disagreement → review, max). Observation confidence bands: official transaction = clamp(conf, 0.9, 1), default 0.95; other evidence = clamp(conf, 0, 0.89), default 0.75. roster_confidence = consensus.confidence when automatic, 1 when manually resolved, otherwise the prior value or 0.4. Pool-status default is 0.7 if verified_active, else 0.4. Roster and transaction data count as stale after 36 h.
consumers: web/pages/fantasy-projections.tsx:236 (confidenceLabel High >= 0.8, Medium >= 0.55, else Low; confidence filter)
calculations.status: live — player-forecasts season roster reconciliation jobs (rosterReconciliation.ts → seasonJobs.ts)

calculations.name: Contribution resolver: detailed/baseline blend and unconditional mean
calculations.purpose: Pick or blend detailed (FORGE) and baseline rates per player-game-target and multiply by participation probability.
calculations.method: lead = UTC-day difference (game - now). Detailed excluded if lead >= horizon. If both valid and compatible (same unit/basis/integration): w = clamp((horizonDays - lead)/7, 0, 1); mean = w*detailed + (1-w)*baseline (so detailed only for lead <= horizon-7, linear fade over last 7 days). unconditionalMean = conditionalMean * participationProbability (1 if participationIntegrated). Falls back to baseline when detailed lacks participation. Exclusion reasons: stale, future_input, identity_conflict, outside_horizon, use_not_approved, etc.
calculations.reference_standard: Forecast combination / horizon-dependent blending
calculations.input_units: per-appearance/per-start means (count or minutes); probability 0-1; calendar days
calculations.output_scale: expected count/minutes per game (unconditional) and conditional mean; blend weight 0-1

Participation precedence: issued forecast probability -> issued appearanceProbability borrowed for baseline -> catalog modeled participation. stats = unconditionalMean when totals allowed.

calculations.name: Team contexts: offense/defense/pace multipliers, schedule-neutral goal differential, team ratings
calculations.purpose: Derives team strength multipliers and percentile ratings from last-season team game stats
inputs: goals for/against, shots for/against, PP 'goals/opps' strings per team-game (2025-26 only)

calculations.name: Hierarchical hits (Poisson-Gamma partial pooling)
calculations.purpose: Predicts hits per game using a per-position Gamma prior on hits per TOI second
calculations.method: player rate = hits/TOI; position mean and variance of unweighted player rates; Gamma alpha = mean^2/var, beta = mean/var (seconds); posterior rate = (hits + alpha)/(TOI + beta); prediction = rate * projected TOI
calculations.reference_standard: Gamma-Poisson conjugate empirical Bayes

calculations.name: Recency-decayed weighted summary (per-player mean/variance and population prior)
calculations.purpose: Computes recency-weighted per-game means, weights and variances per player and the population prior for a target

Skaters missing from team's latest run get no line (stale). Conditioning 'unconditional', startProbability null; expires min(puck drop, issuedAt + 8 days). calculations.name: Bridge goalie per-start line, wins and expected stats
calculations.purpose: Per-start goalie line re-aimed to the opponent, win credit, and expected (x start chance) stats.
inputs: forge_goalie_projections (saves, GA, SA, shutout prob, win prob)
calculations.method: Per start: SAVES, GA, SA, SHUTOUTS=shutout prob, GOALIE_MINUTES 60, GAMES_STARTED 1. Retarget: shots factor = (1+SA_to)/(1+SA_from) x (1+venue_to)/(1+venue_from); GA factor similarly; shutout = min(1, p/GAfactor). Venue/rest context = clamp(oppRest(+0.03 rested / -0.04 B2B) + ownB2B 0.02 + (home -0.01 / away +0.02), -0.15, 0.2). Team win: own/(own+other) if both FORGE values, own/0.984, 1-other/0.984, else FORGE Poisson model on xG priors x rest goal multipliers. WINS = win x 0.984; LOSSES = 1 - WINS. Expected stats = round4(line x startProbability).
calculations.reference_standard: Goalie W = team win x decision share; Poisson/Skellam goal models
calculations.input_units: per-start saves/GA/SA counts, shutout prob 0-1, team win prob 0-1, venue/rest fractional adjustments
calculations.output_scale: expected per-game goalie stats (counts x start prob); wins/losses expected per game 0-1

calculations.name: DUST daily lineup assignment (min-cost max-flow)
calculations.purpose: Assign a day's scheduled roster players to active slot instances, maximising starts then player value.
calculations.method: Bipartite graph source->player(cap1,cost0)->eligible slot(cap1,cost -value)->sink. Successive shortest augmenting paths with Bellman-Ford (EPSILON 1e-10) until no path: maximum cardinality first, then minimum cost (max total value) among max-cardinality matchings. Non-finite value -> 0 with warning. Players/slots sorted by id for deterministic ties; benched = valid players unmatched; invalid-eligibility players are 'unresolved' and excluded.

calculations.input_units: player.value (external canonical value, unitless); one game per player-date
calculations.output_scale: integer counts of started/benched player-games per day

calculations.name: Streaming chain window DP (1 vs 2 spots)

calculations.method: Daily leagues only. budget = floor(period.remaining / acquisitionCost), one acquisition period. Per drop: capacity gain per day = maxMatch(with player) - maxMatch(without). Windows [start,end): candidate plays on days with gain>0 (first day only if claim before puck drop); ranked list top 12. DP best[start][used] = max over end of leg(ranked[0]) + best[end][used+1] (last leg held to end); value compares min(need, starts), then (pointsFirst) points, then games, then points, then fewer adds (1e-9 tolerance). Subtract dropped player's lost games/points/starts from start. Singles: first 3 drops always, more while work <= 2,000,000 and before deadline. Pairs: top 4 single drops, all splits of budget, second spot on top of first. Two-spot recommended only if it beats one-spot.
outputs: alternatives (<=3 other first drops + other-goal best)

calculations.method: Per role, mean and sample SD (n-1) of raw values; goalie SV% regressed: (SA*v + 1200*mean)/(SA+1200); GAA: (GS*v + 25*mean)/(GS+25); z = (v-mean)/sd, inverted for GAA, GA, Losses; score = sum weight*z (weight default 1). Default categories G,A,PPP,SOG,HIT,BLK when no weights.
calculations.reference_standard: Standard category z-score / SGP valuation (replacement-level-relative, rate stats weighted by volume, e.g., Razzball/FanGraphs z-scores)
calculations.input_units: season totals for counts; SV% fraction; GAA goals/60
calculations.status: live — /fantasy-projections page and draft-pro recommendations
red_flags: Goalie values regressed but mean/SD come from unregressed population: shrunk goalies get understated z
Rate stats (SV%, GAA) not volume-weighted (no 'impact' conversion), so a 5-start goalie with good SV% scores like a starter after only 1200-shot shrink
Population = all players passed (no replacement-level or rostered-pool cut)
OTL_GOALIE not inverted although losses are

calculations.name: Start Chart today value, Hungarian lineup and stream gain
calculations.purpose: Today's expected fantasy value per Yahoo player, optimal lineup, and best add/drop gain.
calculations.method: Points: sum(stat*weight) over goalie or skater weights (split by key endsWith '_GOALIE'), null if any stat missing. Categories: single selected category value (GA_GOALIE * -1). Lineup: rectangular Hungarian assignment maximising sum of values with zero-value empty option; locked players preserved. Stream gain = max over legal drops of (revised optimum - base optimum); first 100 Yahoo-ranked FAs.
calculations.reference_standard: ILP / Hungarian assignment for daily lineups (optimal vs greedy)
calculations.status: live — pages/api/v1/account/yahoo/starter-board.ts
red_flags: GAMES_STARTED, SAVE_PERCENTAGE, GOALS_AGAINST_AVERAGE lack '_GOALIE' suffix so they would be applied to skaters and dropped from goalies
Category mode inverts only GOALS_AGAINST_GOALIE, not GAA/losses
Streaming limited to first 100 Yahoo-ranked available players

calculations.method: previous = timeline point on or before target date; ownership: target = today(UTC) - window, delta = latest - previous (pct points), deltaPct = delta; ADP: target = latest date - window, delta = previous - latest, deltaPct = delta/previous*100. Risers delta>0 sorted desc, fallers asc. Sparkline last max(12, window+2) points.

calculations.name: weekScore (Game Grid Week Score)
calculations.purpose: Rank each team's selected week for streaming by games volume, off-night games, win odds and slate crowding.
inputs: totalGamesPerWeek (league regular-season games on included days)
calculations.method: If totalTeamGames==0 return sentinel -100. score = 6*(teamGames - leagueGames/16) + 4*offNights + matchupBonus(+-0.5) + slateCrowding(+-0.25). leagueGames/16 = average team appearances (2 per game / 32 teams). Version string 'schedule-v2-crowding-0.25'. Rank = sort desc, index+1.
calculations.reference_standard: Common fantasy 'games-per-week / off-night' streaming heuristics (e.g., Frozen Tools/Left Wing Lock off-night counts); no calibrated standard
calculations.output_scale: unbounded points around 0 (roughly -20..+30); -100 sentinel for no games
