calculations.name: Skater contextual metric catalogue (per-60 rates, shares, regression metrics)
calculations.purpose: Definitions, formulas, directionality and minimums for every contextual skater ranking metric.
calculations.method: goals/assists/primary_assists/points/sog/shot_attempts(NST iCF)/hits/blocks/ixG/penalties_taken per 60 = count/TOIsec*3600; pp_points_per_60 = PP points / PP TOI *3600 (minToi 120); xGA/60 on-ice (5v5 only, lower better, minToi 600); xS% = ixG/unblocked attempts*100; SAX% = Sh% - xS%; GAx = G - ixG; unrealized xG = ixG - G; on-ice GF% = GF/(GF+GA); on-ice xGF% = xGF/(xGF+xGA) (5v5 only); rel 5v5 GF%/xGF% planned (blocked); offense/defense/MCM/BEAST/results_luck read from skater_composite_ratings. methodologyVersion contextual_rankings_v1.
outputs: metric definitions (higherIsBetter, minimumGp, minimumToiSeconds, isRateStat, denominatorKey, sourceQualityFlags)
calculations.reference_standard: NST per-60 and on-ice share conventions; Evolving-Hockey RAPM for relative metrics
calculations.input_units: counts and TOI seconds from rolling windows; xG in goals
calculations.status: live — registry for /rankings pages and writers; rel_5v5_* are 'planned' (blockedFromLiveMatrix)
red_flags: observation, not audited: shot_attempts_per_60 is documented as NST iCF (incl. blocked), but expected_shooting_percentage/SAX% describe the same shot_attempts field as unblocked (Fenwick) — inconsistent denominator semantics
observation, not audited: SAX% uses attempts not SOG, so 'actual shooting %' is goals/attempts, not NHL Sh% (goals/SOG)
observation, not audited: GAx and unrealized xG are raw counts (not rate) ranked across players with very different TOI
observation, not audited: penalties_taken_per_60 counts penalties not PIM and is not net of penalties drawn

calculations.name: Player matrix composite cells & composite-sort ranking
calculations.purpose: Show composite ratings in the skater matrix and rank players when sorting by a composite.
inputs: skater_composite_ratings offense/defense (overall ?? deployment), mcm_score, results_luck_index, beast_tier
calculations.method: Composite cell 'percentile' = the composite raw value itself (offense/defense/MCM) or clamp(results_luck_index, 0, 100); null if sample minimum not met. Composite sort ranks = rankNormalizedMetricValues over composite values, sign-flipped when sortDirection=asc. Overall value falls back from *_overall to *_deployment.
calculations.status: live — /rankings matrix
red_flags: observation, not audited: composite 0-100 weighted scores are displayed in the percentile slot although they are not percentiles (MCM contract says it is not a percentile)
observation, not audited: results_luck_index (centred at 100, range 0-200) is clamped to 0-100 as a 'percentile', so every hot/normal player (>=100) shows 100
observation, not audited: composite rank depends on sort direction (asc flips sign -> rank 1 = lowest)
observation, not audited: overall ?? deployment fallback can show a deployment-peer composite in an overall column

calculations.name: Player matrix all-strengths TOI per game
calculations.purpose: Display all-strength TOI/GP next to strength-specific rows.
calculations.method: season: toi_seconds_avg_season; last-N: toi_total_lastN / min(seasonGP, N).
calculations.status: live
red_flags: observation, not audited: last-N divisor min(seasonGP, N) disagrees with resolveGamesPlayed in skaterWindowAggregation (which lets last-N span prior season); early-season TOI/GP is overstated when window includes prior-season games

calculations.name: Contextual metric raw value + direction normalization
calculations.purpose: Compute a candidate's raw metric value when only numerator/denominator are supplied and flip lower-is-better metrics before ranking.
calculations.method: If rawValue finite use it; else if denominator>0: rate stats = numerator/denominator*3600 (per-60 from seconds), others = numerator/denominator (ratio, NOT x100). Normalized = -raw when higherIsBetter=false.
calculations.reference_standard: NST per-60 convention (count / TOI minutes * 60)
calculations.input_units: numerator count, denominator TOI seconds (rate) or count
calculations.output_scale: per-60 rate or 0-1 ratio; sign-flipped for lower-is-better
calculations.status: live — called by buildContextualRankingRows
red_flags: observation, not audited: non-rate fallback returns a 0-1 ratio while the same metrics' primary path (skaterWindowAggregation percent()) returns 0-100; unit mismatch only if rawValue is ever missing
observation, not audited: results_luck_index is defined higherIsBetter=false, so ranking inverts 'luckier' to lower percentile

calculations.name: Peer-group sample gating & sample confidence
calculations.purpose: Decide which skaters qualify for ranking and label sample confidence.
calculations.method: Qualified if GP>=minGp and TOI>=minToi (defaults from metric definition, typically minGp 1, minToi 300s; 600s for xGA/60, xS%, SAX%, GAx, on-ice shares; 1200s for luck/relative; 120s for PP points/60). sampleMultiple = min(GP/minGp, TOI/minToi): >=2 high, >=1 medium, else low. Peer groups with <3 qualified get 'small_peer_group' warning (still ranked).
calculations.reference_standard: NST-style minimum TOI filters (e.g. 5v5 TOI cutoffs); Tango reliability-based thresholds
calculations.status: live — every contextual ranking surface
red_flags: observation, not audited: minimum TOI of 300s (5 min) and minGp 1 are very low for per-60 percentiles; small samples dominate tails
observation, not audited: peer groups of 1-2 still receive percentiles (N=1 -> 100)

calculations.name: Contextual ranking percentile & dense rank (rankNormalizedMetricValues)
calculations.purpose: Shared rank/percentile convention for every contextual ranking surface (skater metrics, matrices, deployment tiers, entity_metric_rankings).
calculations.method: Drop non-finite values; sort desc by normalized value (ties by id). Dense rank (ties share rank, next distinct value rank+1). Percentile = 100 * (count of strictly worse qualified peers) / (N-1), rounded to 3 dp; N==1 -> 100. Ties share percentile.
calculations.reference_standard: Standard percentile rank (exclusive, (#below)/(N-1)); compare to mid-rank convention (#below + 0.5*#ties)/N used by NST/HockeyViz-style percentile cards.
calculations.status: live — used by /api/v1/contextual-rankings*, matrices, update-entity-metric-rankings, update-skater-composite-ratings
red_flags: observation, not audited: dense ranking (1,1,2) instead of competition ranking (1,1,3) means rank and 'of N' text can understate distance
observation, not audited: strictly-worse/(N-1) convention gives tied-at-bottom 0 and tied-at-top <100 when ties exist; not mid-rank

calculations.name: Team matrix ranking (power-rating passthrough + percentiles)
calculations.purpose: Rank 19 team metrics (power ratings, style, luck, context, unit usage) with shared percentile convention.
calculations.method: Event window = season start to min(asOf, regular-season end) and capped at latest power date; regular-season games only (type 2). Style totals summed per team; NST 5v5 fallback sums gp and counts across dated rows when team_underlying missing. Each metric ranked via rankNormalizedMetricValues with lowerIsBetter flip (xga60, Pen/60). methodologyVersion team_rankings_v2_season_5v5_asof.
calculations.reference_standard: NST team 5v5 tables
calculations.status: live — methodologyVersion team_rankings_v2_season_5v5_asof (teamMatrix.ts:1671)
red_flags: observation, not audited: NST fallback sums gp and counts across dated rows; percentUnits.ts:62-65 documents nst team rows as one regular-season date per row, so summing appears consistent (verify nst_team_5v5 specifically)
observation, not audited: power-rating columns retain their own strength context while style columns are 5v5 (mixed strengths in one matrix, acknowledged in warnings)
observation, not audited: no minimum-games gate before ranking team style/luck metrics

calculations.name: Team style profile (xGF%, shot quality, event rate, pace/control axes, style badge)
calculations.purpose: Raw 5v5 team style descriptors and a run-and-gun badge for the team matrix.
calculations.method: xGF% = xGF/(xGF+xGA)*100; shot quality = xGF/FF; eventRate = (xGF+xGA)/games (per game, not per 60); league avg = unweighted mean of team event rates; pace: >=1.1x league avg high_event, <=0.9x low_event; control: xGF%>=55 controls_play, <=45 chasing_play. Badge combines axes.
calculations.reference_standard: NST team 5v5 xGF%; score-and-venue adjusted xG (Evolving-Hockey / Micah McCurdy)
calculations.input_units: 5v5 season-to-date xG totals, FF counts, games
calculations.output_scale: xGF% 0-100; xG per FF; xG per game; categorical axes
calculations.status: live — team matrix route /api/v1/contextual-rankings matrix (teams)
red_flags: observation, not audited: not score/venue adjusted (acknowledged in contract)
observation, not audited: event rate is per game rather than per 60 5v5 minutes, so teams with more 5v5 time (fewer penalties) look higher-event
observation, not audited: thresholds 1.1/0.9 and 55/45 are magic numbers

calculations.name: Team luck components (finishing, save, net GAx)
calculations.purpose: Team goals vs expected goals for and against at 5v5.
calculations.method: finishingLuck = GF - xGF; saveLuck = xGA - GA; net = sum. Cumulative counts, ranked across teams.
calculations.reference_standard: GSAx (team-level) / GAx; PDO
calculations.status: live — team matrix
red_flags: observation, not audited: cumulative totals not normalized per game/60 — teams with more games played rank more extreme
observation, not audited: save luck conflates goaltending with skater shot-blocking/xG model error

calculations.name: Team game context components (1-goal rate, home/road gap, PP opp/G, Pen/60)
calculations.purpose: Team game-context metrics for the team matrix.
calculations.method: oneGoalGameRate = % of games with |GF-GA|<=1; homeRoadPointPctGap = (mean home point_pct - mean road point_pct)*100; PP opp rate and Pen/60 = unweighted mean of per-game values.
calculations.input_units: per-game rows: goals, point_pct fraction 0-1, PP opp per game, pen per 60
calculations.output_scale: percent 0-100; point-pct gap x100; per-game; per-60
calculations.status: live — team matrix
red_flags: observation, not audited: Pen/60 is mean of per-game rates rather than total penalties / total TOI
observation, not audited: one-goal rate counts shootout/OT games and excludes empty-net-inflated 2-goal games; point_pct per game row semantics (cumulative vs per-game) not verified

calculations.name: QoT / QoC (quality of teammates / competition) features
calculations.purpose: Per-game and rolling TOI-weighted average teammate and opponent impact percentiles from shift stints.
inputs: player impact rating_0_to_100/100 (offense, defense) at one snapshot
NHL shift stints (durationSeconds, playerIds by team)
calculations.method: Re-percentile ratings within position group x TOI tercile (low/middle/high by TOI rank) using (count<=value - 1)/(N-1). Per stint: QoT = mean teammate offensive/defensive percentile (own skaters excl. self), QoC = mean of all opposing players' percentiles; accumulate weighted by stint seconds; per-game value = sum/TOI. Rolling windows 5/10/20 games = TOI-weighted mean over window. Unit-level QoT/QoC also built.
tables_written: QoT/QoC feature tables (via update-nhl-xg-qot-qoc; exact names in route)
calculations.reference_standard: Evolving-Hockey / NST QoT-QoC (TOI-weighted teammate/opponent TOI% or xGF%); HockeyViz competition metrics
calculations.status: live — /api/v1/db/update-nhl-xg-qot-qoc
red_flags: observation, not audited: a single (latest by default) rating snapshot is applied to all historical games — look-ahead leakage when used as model features
observation, not audited: QoC averages all opposing players without filtering goalies (own-team list filters goalies only); goalies with ratings would enter QoC
observation, not audited: percentiles of percentiles within TOI terciles compress differences; tercile bucketing by TOI couples quality and usage
observation, not audited: likely overlaps the xG agent's slice (lib/xg) — listed here for QoC/QoT coverage

calculations.name: Deployment tier bucket summaries
calculations.purpose: Average percentile per metric per deployment bucket (L1..PK2) and pick top metric/player.
inputs: metric list (default points/goals/assists/ixG/SOG per 60, on-ice xGF%)
calculations.method: EV sections ranked at 5v5 vs whole position group; PP/PK sections ranked across all skaters (or position) at pp/pk strength with minToi forced to 0. Bucket metric average = mean of member percentiles (1dp); bucket average = mean of metric averages; topMetric = max average; sourceState available if >= min(3, #metrics) metrics have averages. Latest row per player within last 30 game dates.
calculations.status: live — /api/v1/contextual-rankings/deployment-tiers, DeploymentTiersPanel
red_flags: observation, not audited: SPECIAL_TEAMS_MIN_TOI_SECONDS = 0 lets tiny PP/PK samples receive percentiles
observation, not audited: default metric on_ice_xgf_percentage is 5v5-only so it is always unavailable in PP/PK sections
observation, not audited: bucket average is an unweighted mean of per-player percentiles (no TOI weighting)
observation, not audited: 'latest row per player within 30 game dates' includes stale rows for players who stopped playing

calculations.name: Deployment bucket assignment (EV line/pair, PP unit, PK tier)
calculations.purpose: Classify skaters into L1-L4, P1-P3, PP1-PP3, PK1-PK2 and aggregate a window's modal deployment with confidence.
inputs: PK TOI per game (toi_seconds_avg_season on pk rows)
EV TOI rank in position group
calculations.method: EV: forward slot clamp 1-4 -> L#, defense slot clamp 1-3 -> P#; fallback from EV TOI rank: forwards ceil(rank/3), D ceil(rank/2). PP: unit clamp 1-3. PK: avg PK TOI/game >=90s -> PK1 else PK2. Window aggregate = mode bucket over most recent teamGamesAvailable games; roleConsistencyShare = mode share; confidence high if coverage>=0.7 and share>=0.7, mixed if >=0.4/0.4, else low. rankingQueries labels deployment confidence 'medium' if EV bucket exists else 'low'.
calculations.reference_standard: Line-combination conventions (Daily Faceoff / NST line tool); PK usage tiers by SH TOI share
calculations.input_units: slot/unit integers; PK TOI seconds per game
calculations.output_scale: categorical buckets L1-L4,P1-P3,PP1-PP3,PK1-PK2; confidence high/mixed/low; share 0-1
calculations.status: live — normalize*Bucket used by rankingQueries/deploymentTiers; buildSkaterDeploymentAggregate/resolveEvDeploymentBucket/assignEvDeploymentBucketFromToiRank have no non-test callers (legacy/dead)
red_flags: observation, not audited: PK1/PK2 split uses a fixed 90 s/game threshold, not team-relative SH TOI share
observation, not audited: rankingQueries uses only the latest row's line slot (single game) for deployment peer group, not the windowed mode aggregate
observation, not audited: hard-coded 'medium'/'low' deployment confidence in rankingQueries ignores confidenceFor()

calculations.name: Team unit-usage indices (forward top load, pair top load, PP1+PP2 share)
calculations.purpose: Team-level top-line/pair/PP-unit concentration from team_unit_toi.
calculations.method: Per game: forwardTopShare = unit_share(forward_line 1)*100; defenseTopShare likewise; PP share = (PP1+PP2 unit seconds)/pool seconds*100. Team index = unweighted mean across games. Label coverage-qualified if status complete and >=3 games.
calculations.status: live — team matrix (source team_unit_toi from update-team-unit-toi)
red_flags: observation, not audited: mean of per-game shares (not pooled seconds) weights short and long games equally
observation, not audited: MIN_TEAM_UNIT_LABEL_GAMES=3 is a very small sample for a style label

calculations.name: Team unit TOI builder (5v5 lines/pairs and PP units, pooled player-seconds)
calculations.purpose: Derive per-game forward-line, defense-pair and PP-unit TOI and shares from raw shifts.
calculations.method: Per game-period, split time at every shift boundary; a segment is 5v5 if both teams have exactly 5 skaters (F or D) on ice; only exact 3F+2D configurations counted. Unit seconds = segment duration x player count (pooled player-seconds); units are exact player sets ranked by pooled seconds -> unit_number 1..k. Coverage partial if any skater has an unclassified position. PP: unit from powerPlayCombinations, pool = sum of PPTOI across all PP players; unit seconds = sum of its players' PPTOI. unit_share (DB generated) = unit_toi_seconds / team_unit_pool_toi_seconds.
calculations.reference_standard: NST/HockeyViz line-combination TOI (5v5 shared ice time)
calculations.input_units: shift seconds within period; PPTOI seconds
calculations.status: live — update-team-unit-toi registered in route runner (web/lib/routeRunner/registry.ts:156)
red_flags: observation, not audited: 5v5 detection counts skaters only (goalie presence not checked), so 5v5 with a pulled goalie in some edge cases may be included
observation, not audited: line 1 is defined as the most-used exact trio in that game, so line shuffles fragment units and lower 'top load'
observation, not audited: PP unit membership comes from powerPlayCombinations.unit (external), while pool is total PPTOI incl. units 3+ — PP1/PP2 share depends on that labelling

calculations.name: Goalie value signal (avg of GSAx and GSAA)
calculations.purpose: Single saved-goals signal blending two goalie value measures.
calculations.method: Mean of non-null of {GSAx, GSAA}; metric marked unavailable if either source partial in window.
calculations.reference_standard: GSAx (xG baseline) vs GSAA (league-average SV% baseline) are distinct standards
calculations.status: live — goalie matrix
red_flags: observation, not audited: averages two metrics with different baselines (shot-quality vs league-average SV%), cumulative so favours workload
observation, not audited: function itself averages whichever is present (1 or 2 values) — fallback differs from column description 'when both are present'

calculations.name: Goalie relative SV% (vs same-team other goalies)
calculations.purpose: Goalie 5v5 SV% minus teammates' 5v5 SV% over the latest team's game window.
inputs: NST 5v5 saves, shots_against per goalie per team game
calculations.method: Team window = team's last N scheduled games (N per window); requires exactly one starter per game and complete attribution. Rel SV% = goalie saves/SA - (team saves - goalie saves)/(team SA - goalie SA); null if teammate baseline SA < 50.
calculations.reference_standard: dSV% / team-relative save percentage
calculations.status: live — goalie matrix
red_flags: observation, not audited: team-relative baseline with 50-shot minimum is noisy; goalie and teammates face different opponents/schedules
observation, not audited: player performance window (goalie appearances) and relative SV% window (team games) differ (acknowledged in roleNotes)

calculations.name: Goalie matrix sample gate, confidence and ranking
calculations.purpose: Qualify goalies by starts/shots and rank 11 goalie metrics.
calculations.method: Population anchored on official WGO appearances (regular season type 2, games_played>0), NST advanced fields joined by player/date only when unique. Qualified if starts>=minStarts and SA>=minShots and role matches; confidence high if min(starts/minStarts, SA/minShots)>=2 else medium; below min -> low. Ranked with shared percentile convention; RBS% lower-is-better.
calculations.status: live — goalie matrix
red_flags: observation, not audited: role filter is applied before ranking so percentiles are within-role, changing meaning with the filter
observation, not audited: default minimum 3 starts / 100 shots is a tiny sample for SV%-type metrics (SV% SD ~ .015 at 1,000 shots)

calculations.name: Goalie window aggregation (SV%, 5v5 GSAx, GSAA/60, xGA/shot, HD SV%)
calculations.purpose: Aggregate a goalie's last-N or season appearances into rate metrics for the goalie matrix.
inputs: nst_5v5_counts_toi, xg_against, goals_against, gsaa, saves, shots_against, hd_saves, hd_shots_against
calculations.method: Window = goalie's last 5/10/20 appearances (or season) across teams. SV% = sum saves / sum SA (all situations, WGO). GSAx = sum(NST 5v5 xGA - NST 5v5 GA) (cumulative). GSAA/60 = sum NST 5v5 GSAA / sum NST 5v5 TOI *3600. xGA/shot = 5v5 xGA / 5v5 shots against. HD SV% = 5v5 HD saves / HD SA. Any missing per-game component marks the metric unavailable for the whole window.
calculations.reference_standard: GSAx = xGA - GA (MoneyPuck/Evolving-Hockey, all unblocked shots, all situations); NST GSAA and HD SV% definitions
calculations.output_scale: SV% fraction 0-1; GSAx goals; GSAA per 60; xG per shot fraction; HD SV% fraction 0-1
calculations.status: live — goalie matrix (methodologyVersion goalie_rankings_v4_official_appearance_population, goalieMatrix.ts:1582)
red_flags: observation, not audited: GSAx is 5v5-only and cumulative (not per 60/per shot) while SV% is all-situations — mixed strengths in one matrix
observation, not audited: GSAx uses NST xG (shots-on-goal based) whereas GSAx reference uses unblocked attempts
observation, not audited: minShots gate (default 100) is on all-situations SA, not on the 5v5 sample used by GSAx/HD SV%
observation, not audited: xGA per shot uses NST shots_against (SOG) not Fenwick, inconsistent with xgDenominatorSemantics Fenwick contract

calculations.name: Goalie quality start / really bad start / steal game classification
calculations.purpose: Per-start binary classifications used for QS%, RBS% and steal rate.
calculations.method: modern_gsax mode (default): QS if GSAx>=0; RBS if GSAx<=-2; steal if won and GSAx>=1. classic mode: QS if SV%>=0.900 (or >=0.885 when SA<20); RBS if SV%<=0.850; steal if SA>=30 and SV%>=0.930 and won. Matrix: QS% = WGO quality_start / starts (not this function); RBS% and steal rate use modern mode with per-game 5v5 GSAx; rates = count/starts.
calculations.reference_standard: Rob Vollman Quality Start (SV% >= league avg or >=.885 on <20 shots) and Really Bad Start (SV% < .850)
calculations.status: live — goalie matrix (RBS/steal); isGoalieQualityStart likely test-only
red_flags: observation, not audited: QS% uses WGO/NHL quality_start while RBS%/steal use 5v5-only GSAx thresholds designed per game — inconsistent definitions in one row
observation, not audited: classic leagueAverageSavePct hard-coded 0.900 rather than seasonal league average
observation, not audited: isGoalieQualityStart has no production caller in matrix (QS read from WGO)

calculations.name: Goalie role / start-share buckets and adjusted core netshare
calculations.purpose: Classify goalie role (G1 workhorse..G2 reserve) from start share; optional core-tandem netshare excluding emergency starts.
inputs: team starts by goalie in window
calculations.method: roleShare = projected season_start_pct (matching team) else raw window share = goalie starts / team starts. Deployment bucket: >=0.65 g1_workhorse, >=0.55 g1_starter, >=0.45 g1a_tandem_lead, >=0.30 g1b, >=0.10 g2_backup, else g2_reserve. coreStartShare = starts / top-2 goalies' starts. Role confidence high if confirmed projection, medium if projection, else medium/low by core status. calculateAdjustedCoreNetshare = core starts / starts excluding emergency call-ups when both core goalies absent with >=medium confidence. start_share metric = projection season_start_pct ?? adjusted(null) ?? raw.
consumers: goalie matrix role filter & start_share metric
calculations.status: live — goalie matrix (bucket); calculateAdjustedCoreNetshare unknown/likely test-only
red_flags: observation, not audited: start_share metric mixes a projection field and an observed window share in one ranked column
observation, not audited: adjustedStartShare hard-coded null (goalieMatrix.ts:1064); calculateAdjustedCoreNetshare and getGoalieStartsShareBucket have no matrix callers
observation, not audited: thresholds 0.65/0.55/0.45/0.30/0.10 are magic numbers

calculations.name: Results Luck Index (non-overlapping rate version with peer blend shrinkage)
calculations.purpose: Older single-metric luck index: current per-60 vs season-remainder per-60 blended toward peer average when baseline TOI is thin.
calculations.method: Baseline numerator/denominator = season minus current; player baseline = per-60; weight w = clamp01(baselineTOI/1200 s); baseline = w*player + (1-w)*peer; index = current/baseline*100.
calculations.reference_standard: Linear shrinkage toward population mean (Tango regression to the mean)
calculations.status: legacy/dead — no non-test callers of calculateNonOverlappingResultsLuckIndex/canPersistResultsLuckIndex
red_flags: observation, not audited: legacy/dead — no production callers
observation, not audited: shrinkage constant 1200 s (20 min) TOI is far below reliability thresholds for per-60 scoring rates

calculations.name: Results Luck Index (component-aware, written)
calculations.purpose: Index (100 = normal) of whether a skater's current-window results run hot/cold vs a non-overlapping season-remainder baseline.
inputs: goals/ixG/shot_attempts totals for window and season
calculations.method: Baseline = season total minus current-window total. Components: GAx (G-ixG) signed, scale 2, weight 0.35; SAX% (G/att - ixG/att, x100) signed, scale 10, weight 0.25; IPP% ratio, weight 0.20; on-ice GF-xGF signed, scale 4, weight 0.20. Signed component index = clamp(100 + (current-baseline)/scale*100, 0, 200); ratio index = clamp(current/baseline*100, 0, 200). Index = weighted mean of usable components. Publish only if all weights usable and baseline window excluded (or season + peer_fallback). Season window uses last20 as current and has no baseline. Interpretation bands: >=120 hot, 105-119 slightly hot, 95-105 normal, 80-94 slightly cold, <=79 cold.
calculations.reference_standard: PDO / regression-to-mean of shooting % and on-ice Sh% (Tango-style true-talent regression)
calculations.input_units: goal counts, xG goals, attempt counts, IPP percent 0-100
calculations.status: live — update-skater-composite-ratings when source coverage verified
red_flags: observation, not audited: GAx and on-ice GF-xGF components compare a last-N window COUNT with a season-remainder COUNT (different sample sizes) — signed difference is not rate-normalized
observation, not audited: baseline = season total minus last-N total, but last-N windows can include prior-season games (skaterWindowAggregation.ts:243), so the remainder can be wrong or negative
observation, not audited: SAX% uses shot_attempts (iCF vs Fenwick ambiguity) as denominator
observation, not audited: scales 2/10/4 and 0-200 clamp are magic numbers
observation, not audited: season-window rows can never publish (no peer fallback wired), so season results_luck_index is always null

calculations.purpose: Define the composite ranking population (latest regular-season appearance per player) and verify rolling rows exist for each.
calculations.method: Regular season = game_id digits 5-6 == 02; latest appearance per player since Sept 1 of season start through cutoff; each must have a rolling row at that exact date for the requested strength; caps 60,000 WGO rows and 40x50 player chunks; any gap -> blocker.
calculations.status: live — update-skater-composite-ratings
red_flags: observation, not audited: players' windows are taken at their own last-game date, so injured/scratched players are ranked on stale windows alongside current ones
observation, not audited: for pp/pk strength a player whose last game has no PP/PK rolling row blocks publication (strict but may make PP composites unpublishable)
observation, not audited: 2,000-player cap (40 x 50) on coverage queries

calculations.name: Skater composite publication gate & population re-check
calculations.purpose: Verify published percentiles reproduce from the raw population and block partial/combined-filter publication.
calculations.method: Recompute percentile per peer group = 100*worse/(N-1) (N=1 -> 100), compare within 1e-6; blockers for unverified coverage, snapshot mismatch, duplicates, peer-group inconsistency, truncation, >1 combined filter, custom minGp!=1 or minToi!=300. Upsert <=1000 rows atomically.
calculations.status: live — update-skater-composite-ratings
red_flags: observation, not audited: re-check treats every component as higher-is-better (comment line 201); fine for MCM components but xga_per_60 (lower-is-better) is excluded from requiredMetrics only by construction
observation, not audited: durable key only supports minGp=1/minToi=300 — the published composite always uses the very low default sample floor

calculations.name: Offense Rating (skater composite)
calculations.purpose: Percentile-weighted contextual offensive composite per skater/window/strength/peer group.
inputs: percentiles of goals_per_60, points_per_60, ixg_per_60, shot_attempts_per_60, sog_per_60, primary_assists_per_60, assists_per_60, expected_shooting_percentage, sax_percentage, goals_above_expected
calculations.method: Sub-scores = mean of available component percentiles: scoring_rate(G/60,P/60), chance_creation(ixG/60, iCF/60, SOG/60), playmaking(A1/60, A/60), finishing_context(xS%, SAX%, GAx). Offense = weighted mean 0.35/0.30/0.20/0.15 over non-null sub-scores (weights renormalized), clamp 0-100, round 2. Written to offense_rating_overall or _deployment depending on deployment filter.
calculations.reference_standard: Evolving-Hockey EV/PP offense GAR components; percentile-card composites (JFresh)
calculations.output_scale: 0-100 weighted percentile score (not itself a percentile)
calculations.status: live — written by /api/v1/db/update-skater-composite-ratings (methodology contextual_composites_v2)
red_flags: observation, not audited: missing components are silently dropped and weights renormalized, unlike MCM which requires all inputs ('never reweight') — inconsistent policies in the same writer
observation, not audited: components are highly collinear (G/60 and P/60; ixG/60, iCF/60, SOG/60; A1/60 and A/60), so effective weight on shot volume is larger than labelled
observation, not audited: a rating built from a single available component still publishes as a full 0-100 rating
observation, not audited: finishing context includes GAx (count, TOI-dependent) alongside percentages

calculations.name: Defense Rating / Defensive Impact in Context (skater composite)
calculations.purpose: Percentile-weighted contextual defensive composite.
inputs: percentiles of xga_per_60 (direction-flipped), on_ice_xgf_percentage, on_ice_gf_percentage, blocks_per_60
calculations.method: suppression = pct(xGA/60); on_ice_process = mean(pct on-ice xGF%, pct on-ice GF%); physical_support = pct(blocks/60). Defense = weighted mean 0.45/0.35/0.20 over non-null sub-scores (renormalized), clamp 0-100, round 2.
calculations.reference_standard: Evolving-Hockey defensive RAPM/GAR (xGA suppression controlling for teammates, competition, zone, score)
calculations.status: live — update-skater-composite-ratings
red_flags: observation, not audited: xga_per_60 and on_ice_xgf_percentage are 5v5-only and are marked unavailable for strength all/ev/pp/pk (rankingQueries.ts:668), so non-5v5 defense ratings reduce to on-ice GF% + blocks with renormalized weights (~64/36)
observation, not audited: on-ice GF% and xGF% are offense+defense shares, not defensive-only; blocks/60 rewards being hemmed in
observation, not audited: no teammate/competition/zone/score adjustment (acknowledged in caveats)

calculations.name: MCM Score (multi-category fantasy composite)
calculations.purpose: Fantasy multi-category peripheral/scoring score from component percentiles.
inputs: scoring percentiles: goals_per_60, primary_assists_per_60, points_per_60, pp_points_per_60 (all/pp strength only)
calculations.method: Requires every component percentile valid (no reweighting); percentile only accepted if sample met, peer count>=3, same peer group & snapshot. MCM = 0.45*mean(top 2 riff pct) + 0.35*max(scoring pct) + 0.20*mean(all component pct); round 2.
calculations.reference_standard: Fantasy category z-score/value-over-replacement methods (e.g. standard H2H category z-scores)
calculations.status: live — update-skater-composite-ratings
red_flags: observation, not audited: 6-input (5v5/ev/pk) and 7-input (all/pp) variants share one column; values not comparable across strengths (acknowledged)
observation, not audited: overlapping scoring components (G, A1, P, PPP) double count production
observation, not audited: uses per-60 rates, whereas fantasy categories are totals — high-rate low-TOI players can score high

calculations.name: BEAST tier classification
calculations.purpose: Tier label (BEAST+, BEAST, MCM, MCM Watch) from MCM score and category percentile counts.
calculations.method: First gate passed wins: BEAST+ MCM>=88, >=3 riff>=80, >=2 scoring>=75, >=4 all>=80; BEAST MCM>=80, >=2 riff>=75, >=1 scoring>=70, >=4 all>=70; MCM MCM>=70, >=2 riff>=70, >=1 scoring>=60; MCM Watch no MCM floor, >=2 riff>=60, >=1 scoring>=60. Compares unrounded score.
calculations.status: live — update-skater-composite-ratings
red_flags: observation, not audited: thresholds are hand-set magic numbers; BEAST+ riff requirement '3 riff >=80' equals all riff categories
observation, not audited: MCM Watch has no score floor

calculations.name: Skater archetype scores & tags (shoot-first, pass-first, play-driver)
calculations.purpose: Proxy archetype scores and tags from component percentiles.
inputs: percentiles: shot_attempts_per_60, sog_per_60, primary_assists_per_60, assists_per_60, on_ice_xgf_percentage
calculations.method: shootFirst = wavg(iCF pct 0.55, SOG pct 0.35, (100-A1 pct) 0.10); passFirst = wavg(A1 0.6, A 0.3, (100-iCF) 0.1); playDriver = wavg(on-ice xGF% 0.5, iCF 0.25, A1 0.25); renormalize over non-null. Tags: shoot_first iCF>=75 & A1<70; pass_first A1>=75 & iCF<70; play_driver xGF%>=70 & max(iCF,A1)>=70; high_shot_volume score>=85; high_playmaking >=85.
calculations.status: live — update-skater-composite-ratings
red_flags: observation, not audited: tags treat a missing opposing percentile as 0 (?? 0), so shoot_first/pass_first fire when the other component is unavailable
observation, not audited: play-driver uses 5v5-only on-ice xGF%, unavailable for non-5v5 strengths -> score falls back to iCF/A1 only

calculations.name: xG denominator semantics helpers (xS%, SAX%, team shot quality, goalie xGA per Fenwick)
calculations.purpose: Fenwick-denominator helpers for expected shooting %, shooting above expected, team xG/FF, goalie xGA/FA.
source_tables: nhl_xg_player_rolling_aggregates / team / goalie aggregates (by field name)
calculations.method: xS% = ixG/unblocked*100; SAX% = (G - ixG)/unblocked*100; team shot quality = xGF/FF; goalie xGA per unblocked = xGA/FA (6dp). Denominator must be >0.
consumers: teamMatrix.ts uses the teamStyleMethodology duplicate; xgDenominatorSemantics exports have no non-test callers found via rg
calculations.reference_standard: MoneyPuck/Evolving-Hockey xG per Fenwick (unblocked) attempt
calculations.output_scale: percent 0-100 (xS%, SAX%); xG per attempt fraction

calculations.purpose: Client-side percentile banding for score tiles and player snapshot highlights.
calculations.method: Tones: >=95 peak, >=90 elite, >=80 strong, >=60 positive, >=40 neutral, >=20 weak, else poor. Strengths: top 4 metrics with percentile >=80 else top 3; weak spots: up to 4 with percentile <=39. TOI/G = round(TOI/GP).

calculations.name: Skater window aggregation from rolling rows (per-60 / derived metrics)
calculations.purpose: Turn one rolling_player_game_metrics row into per-window metric values, numerators, denominators, GP and TOI for ranking.
calculations.method: Windows season,last5,last10,last20. Rate = num/den*3600 (6dp); direct stored *_per_60_{window} value preferred over recomputation. points/pp_points season = avg_season * season GP (num and den). Derived: xS% = ixG/shot_attempts*100; SAX% = G/att*100 - ixG/att*100; GAx = G-ixG; unrealized = ixG-G; xGA/60 = oi_xga/toi*3600; on-ice GF% = GF/(GF+GA)*100; xGF% likewise. Season derived on-ice/xGA metrics use *_avg_season fields (ratio of per-game averages).
calculations.reference_standard: NST per-60 convention; on-ice GF%/xGF% = For/(For+Against)
calculations.input_units: TOI seconds; counts; season fields are per-game averages (*_avg_season) or season totals
calculations.status: live — used by rankingQueries/deploymentTiers/entityMetricRankingWriter
red_flags: observation, not audited: for season xGA/60 the denominator is toi_seconds_avg_season (a per-game average) and resolveToiSeconds returns it as the sample TOI, so the 600s minimum TOI gate is compared to per-game TOI, not total TOI
observation, not audited: direct stored per-60 field and recomputed numerator/denominator can disagree; direct field wins silently
observation, not audited: derived season GAx/unrealized xG use season totals but last-N use totals — not rate-normalized, so season vs last5 values are not comparable

calculations.name: Last-N window games-played / TOI resolution
calculations.purpose: Estimate games in a last-N window and the TOI used for sample gates.
calculations.method: Season: participation GP (strength-specific field unless 'all'). Last-N: GP = min(N, round(windowTOI/windowAvgTOI)) when avg present; else N if season GP>=N; else N if windowTOI > seasonAvgTOI*seasonGP*1.05 (window spans prior season); else season GP. Season TOI = denominator or avgTOI*GP.
calculations.status: live — buildSkaterWindowAggregatesFromRollingRow

calculations.purpose: Show the same skater metric across strengths, windows and deployment buckets.

calculations.name: Trending percentile deltas, trend score & opportunity signals
calculations.purpose: Detect skaters whose recent percentiles/TOI moved vs longer windows.
calculations.method: deltaLast5VsLast20 = pct(last5) - pct(last20); deltaLast5VsSeason likewise (1dp). trendScore = mean of last5-vs-last20 percentile deltas across selected metrics. TOI signal if |TOI/G last5 - last20| >= 30 s; severity 30/60/120 s. Shot-volume spike if iCF/60 (else SOG/60) percentile delta >= 8; severity 8/15/25 pts. Rows sorted by trendScore. Min GP per window via minGpForComparisonWindow.
calculations.reference_standard: Rolling-window form indicators; compare with EWMA or Bayesian updated rates
calculations.status: live — /api/v1/contextual-rankings/trending
red_flags: observation, not audited: last5 is a subset of last20 (overlapping windows) so deltas understate change and are partially self-correlated
observation, not audited: percentiles in each window come from different qualified peer pools (min GP 2 vs 5), so percentile deltas mix player change with population change
observation, not audited: no sample-size/regression adjustment — a 5-game percentile is very noisy; thresholds 8/15/25 and 30/60/120 are magic numbers

calculations.name: Team-vs-opponent splits (skater/goalie aggregates, PP share, QS)
calculations.purpose: Current-season player stats for a team against a chosen opponent, plus landing leaders.
inputs: per-game strength rows (toi_es/pp/pk seconds, goals/assists/shots by strength)
calculations.method: Sum ES+PP+PK TOI and counts vs opponent; P/GP; Sh% = G/SOG; avg TOI = total/GP; PP TOI/G; PP% (share) = player PP TOI / team PP TOI vs that opponent; PP shot share = player PP shots / roster PP shots. Goalie SV% = saves/SA; GAA = GA*3600/TOI; QS if SV% > .910 or (SA <= 20 and SV% >= .885); QS% = QS/GS.
calculations.reference_standard: Vollman Quality Start (SV% >= league avg, or >= .885 on <=20 shots)
calculations.status: live — /api/v1/splits
red_flags: observation, not audited: third distinct quality-start definition (> .910) vs goalieMethodology classic (>= .900) and WGO quality_start
observation, not audited: tiny opponent-specific samples (1-4 games) presented without sample gates

calculations.name: Season-decayed player impact priors
calculations.purpose: Blend multiple seasons of impact ratings with fixed season decay weights.
inputs: rating rows (rating_raw, rating_0_to_100, sample_games, sample_toi_seconds) by season
calculations.method: Season weight by age: current 1.0, prior 0.65, two back 0.35, three back 0.20, else 0 (overridable). ratingRaw = sum(w*rating_raw)/sum(w); re-ranked to ordinal percentile 0-100. sample games/TOI summed across all input rows.

calculations.name: Player impact ratings (skater offense/defense, goalie) — z-score composite with TOI shrinkage
calculations.purpose: Season-to-date 0-100 impact ratings for skaters (offense, defense) and goalies from NST game logs.
inputs: nst_*_per_60 (points, goals, first assists, ixG, shots, iCF, oi xGF/xGA/CA/SCA, blocks, takeaways, giveaways, def zone starts)
goalie saves, SA, GA, TOI, nst_all/5v5 GSAA, gsaa_per_60, quality_starts_pct
calculations.method: Per player, TOI-weighted mean of per-game per-60 rates over all game rows <= snapshot. Components z-scored across all players (population SD; missing -> z=0). Offense = 0.24 P/60 + 0.16 G/60 + 0.12 A1/60 + 0.16 ixG/60 + 0.10 SOG/60 + 0.08 iCF/60 + 0.08 oiXGF/60 + 0.06 (oiXGF%-50). Defense = 0.24 -oiXGA/60 + 0.14 -oiCA/60 + 0.12 -oiSCA/60 + 0.16 (oiXGF%-50) + 0.12 (oiCF%-50) + 0.10 blocks/60 + 0.08 (TK-GV)/60 + 0.04 DZS/60. Goalie = 0.50 GSAA/60 + 0.28 SV% + 0.12 QS% + 0.10 -GA/60. Raw x shrink factor TOI/(TOI+k), k=3600 s skaters, 2400 s goalies. rating_0_to_100 = ordinal percentile 100*(1 - index/(N-1)).
calculations.reference_standard: Evolving-Hockey RAPM/GAR; standard z-score composites with position-specific pools
calculations.input_units: per-60 rates; percentages 0-100 for oi%; TOI seconds (assumed); SV% fraction
calculations.status: live — /api/v1/db/update-player-impact-ratings
red_flags: observation, not audited: forwards and defensemen z-scored in one pool (no position adjustment)
observation, not audited: missing components contribute z=0 (imputed league mean) rather than being excluded
observation, not audited: no minimum-TOI filter before percentile ranking — every player with any TOI gets a 0-100 rating; shrinkage only scales raw score
observation, not audited: TOI weight uses nst_toi ?? toi_per_game — units (minutes vs seconds) of nst_toi not verified; if nst_toi is minutes and toi_per_game seconds, weights mix units
observation, not audited: goalie GSAA uses nst_all_counts_gsaa ?? nst_5v5_counts_gsaa per row (mixed strengths across rows)
observation, not audited: defense rewards more defensive-zone starts per 60 (usage, not impact); oiXGF% edge counted in both offense and defense
observation, not audited: weights are hand-set magic numbers, collinear components (P/60 & G/60 & A1/60)

calculations.name: Legacy NST career averages (unweighted mean of season rows)
calculations.purpose: Return a player's career-average S%, xS%, IPP, oiSH%, secA%, A1, A2, points, SOG/60, oZS%, iHDCF, iSCF, ixG, xG%, CF%, goals for the sustainability-vs-career chart.

calculations.method: Each metric = sum over every season row of the per-season value / number of rows (unweighted). xS% = mean of per-season ixG/Shots; secA% = mean of A2/A; SOG/60 = mean of Shots/parseTime(TOI)*60 using lib/NHL/TOI parseTime (minutes). Percent fields divided by 100 at the end (S%, IPP, oiSH%, oZS%).

calculations.output_scale: fractions 0-1 for percentages; per-season mean counts; SOG/60 per-60

calculations.name: Gamma / Beta / Normal trend band (value, CI, z, percentile)
calculations.purpose: Per player/metric/window: decayed EWMA, shrunk value, 80% band, pseudo-z and band percentile.
calculations.method: Take first N samples. Gamma: decayed counts/minutes, ewma=60*Σwc/Σwe; value=blend(ewma,baseline,nEff=Σwe minutes,k=prior); prior shape0=baseline/60*k+1e-3, rate0=k+1e-3; CI = gamma 10/90% quantiles*60. Beta: ewma=Σws/Σwt; value=blend(n=Σwt); alpha0=baseline*k+0.5, beta0=(1-baseline)*k+0.5; CI beta 10/90%. Normal: ewma=Σwv/Σw; var=max(Σwv²/Σw-ewma²,1e-4); margin=1.28155*sd/max(sqrt(Σw),1); value=blend. z=(value-baseline)/((upper-lower)/(2*1.28155)); percentile=clamp(10+80*(value-lower)/(upper-lower),0,100).
calculations.reference_standard: Bayesian shrinkage bands; compare with NST rolling averages

calculations.name: Beta-binomial empirical-Bayes window z (eb_z)
calculations.purpose: Standardise a window rate against the player's (or league) Beta baseline using beta-binomial predictive variance.
inputs: alpha0,beta0 (player posterior if same position group, else league prior)
calculations.method: strength=a+b; priorMean=a/strength; priorVar=ab/(strength^2(strength+1)); p_hat=s/n; shrink=strength/(strength+n); varMixed=priorMean(1-priorMean)(strength+n)/(n(strength+1)) [beta-binomial predictive variance of s/n]; z=(p_hat-priorMean)/max(sqrt(varMixed),sqrt(1e-9)). n=0 -> z=0. Non-finite outputs replaced by 0 before persist. Rounded z to 6dp.
calculations.reference_standard: Beta-binomial predictive distribution; Tango regression to the mean

calculations.name: Power ratings: league distribution, early-season blend, z-scores
calculations.sub_family: Team ratings / power / CTPI / SOS / power ratings
calculations.purpose: Standardizes each team's EWMA rates against the league for the date.
inputs: EWMA metrics of teams with a game on targetDate
calculations.method: league avg and sample SD (n-1) per metric; gpWeight = clamp(gp_to_date/10,0,1); blended = gpWeight*ewma + (1-gpWeight)*leagueAvg for xGF/GF/SF/xGA/GA/SA/pace; z = (blended - avg)/sd (0 if sd=0). Derived: finishing = GF60 - xGF60, goalie = xGA60 - GA60, danger = HDCF/(HDCF+HDCA) (0.5 if 0), ppOff, pkDef, discipline, pdo (pdo_z 0 if null).
calculations.reference_standard: Z-score standardization; Bayesian shrinkage to league mean

calculations.name: views nst_percentile_{es,pk,pp}_{offense,defense}_filtered
calculations.purpose: Mid-rank percentiles of per-60 metrics within season among players with >= 25% of the player's GP
calculations.method: pct(metric) = (COUNT(b: b.metric <= a.metric) + 0.5*COUNT(b: b.metric = a.metric)) / COUNT(b non-null), pool b = same season with b.gp >= ceil(a.gp*0.25). Correlated subquery per metric. ga/sa percentiles hard-coded NULL::text in defense.
calculations.reference_standard: percent_rank / cume_dist; mid-rank = (count(<) + 0.5*count(=))/N
calculations.status: legacy/dead — only referenced in web/e2e/fixtures/wigo/schema.json; client reads unfiltered base views

observation, not audited: comparison pool depends on the subject's own GP (each player ranked against a different population)
observation, not audited: defense metrics (CA/60 etc.) ranked ascending, so more shots against = higher percentile (no inversion)

calculations.name: Legacy NST three-year and career count averages (ThreeYearAverages)
calculations.purpose: Scrape a player's NST season-by-season individual and on-ice counts and return 3-year and career per-season averages plus derived shares.
inputs: NST playerreport.php sit=all rate=n tables indreg and reg: Shots, Goals, assists, A1/A2, TOI, iCF/iFF/ixG/iSCF/iHDCF, CF/CA/FF/FA/SF/SA/GF/GA/xGF/xGA/SCF/SCA/HD/MD/LD, zone starts

calculations.method: Per season: multi-team seasons summed into a TOT row (S% = G/SOG, secA% = A2/A, oZS% = oZS/(oZS+dZS), SOG/60 = SOG/TOI*60, IPP = (G+A)/oiGF, CF%/FF%/SF%/SCF%/xGF%/GF% = F/(F+A)). 3YA picks the 3 most recent seasons EXCLUDING the latest season (TOT row if traded), sums each count and divides by 3; throws if fewer than 3 prior seasons. Shares recomputed from 3-season totals. Career = same over all seasons except the latest, divided by number of seasons.
outputs: threeYearCountsAverages (toi, counts, CF%, FF%, SF%, GF%, xGF%, SCF%, IPP, S%, xS%, SOG/60, oZS%, oiSH%, secA%)

calculations.input_units: NST TOI decimal minutes converted to seconds by local parseTime; counts are season totals; percentages as fractions 0-1
calculations.output_scale: per-season average counts; shares as fraction 0-1; SOG/60 mislabelled (per-minute)

calculations.name: Legacy NST three-year and career rate averages (per-60) with TOT rate rows

inputs: NST playerreport rate=y: CF/60, CA/60, iSCF/60, PTS/60, G/60, A/60, A1/60, A2/60, SOG/60, SF/60, SA/60, GF/60, GA/60, xGF/60, xGA/60, SCF/60, SCA/60, iCF/60, iFF/60, FF/60, FA/60, ixG/60, HD/MD/LD CF/GF per 60, PIM/HIT/BLK per 60, TOI

Shares (CF%, FF%, SF%, GF%, xGF%, SCF%) computed from SUMS of per-60 rates across seasons.
calculations.reference_standard: TOI-weighted pooling of per-60 rates (sum counts / sum TOI), as NST and Evolving-Hockey do for multi-season views

calculations.method: Integer counts summed; nullable metrics (ixg, iScf, iHdcf, xgf, xga, scf, hdcf, md*, xgAgainst...) summed with addNullable (null deltas skipped, total stays null only if every game is null). TOI summed only when every game has reliable TOI (else toiSeconds=null). Goalie avg shot/goal distance = sum(avg_distance*count)/sum(count) (count-weighted). Rates/percentages are then computed from the totals (ratio of sums).
outputs: aggregate metrics per player or player-team
calculations.reference_standard: Ratio-of-sums convention (NST season totals)

calculations.name: PBP game-clock reconstruction (period duration, game seconds elapsed, seconds since previous event)
calculations.purpose: Derive absolute game time per stored PBP event before running shot features / NST parity.
calculations.method: Period duration = elapsed + remaining if both known, else SO=0, OT=300 s, otherwise 1200 s. gameSecondsElapsed = (period_number-1) * base + elapsed where base = 1200 when period<=3 OR duration unknown, else base = that period's own duration. secondsSincePrevious = elapsed(this) - elapsed(previous). Also tags own goals from landing payload summary.scoring goalModifier.
calculations.reference_standard: NHL API period clock (20-min regulation, 5-min regular-season OT, 20-min playoff OT)
calculations.status: live — read by pages/api/v1/underlying-stats/players.ts and goalies.ts (+[playerId], chart) for /underlying-stats/playerStats and /goalieStats; summaries written by pages/api/v1/db/update-player-underlying-stats.ts, which runs from the lineCombinations insert trigger (supabase/migrations/20260716112910_harden_line_combination_trigger_auth.sql:130) and the pg_cron job 'update-player-underlying-stats-yesterday' at 09:35 UTC (tasks/TASKS/cron-operations/cron-schedule.md:382,827)

calculations.name: Strength of schedule (direct + indirect opponent point %)
calculations.purpose: Past and future schedule strength per team for the ratings landing.
calculations.method: Direct = opponents' combined point% = (2W + OTL)/(2*(W+L+OTL)). Indirect = games-weighted mean of each opponent's own direct value for the same bucket (opponents' opponents). Bucket SOS = (2*direct + indirect)/3 (falls back to whichever exists). Overall sos = mean(past, future). Rank 1 = highest SOS (hardest), ordinal, null-last.
calculations.reference_standard: RPI-style SOS (2/3 OWP + 1/3 OOWP); NHL point %
calculations.output_scale: point% fraction 0-1; SOS fraction 0-1; rank 1..N (1 = hardest)

calculations.name: Heuristic approximate xG per shot
calculations.purpose: Assign an expected-goal value to each unblocked/blocked attempt for team and fallback individual xG.
calculations.method: Hand-set lookup, not a trained model. Per shot: base 0.18 high / 0.08 medium / 0.02 low danger; +0.03 rebound, +0.02 rush, +0.02 royal-road crossing; if goal, value=max(value,0.25); cap 0.95; null if distance/angle missing. INCLUDES: x,y normalized to the attacking direction by mirroring (x,y)->(-x,-y) when the shooting team attacks the left side, from home_team_defending_side (web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlCoordinates.ts:51); net fixed at (89,0); distance = Euclidean feet to (89,0) (nhlShotFeatureBuilder.ts:182); angle = atan2(|dy|,|dx|) degrees (nhlShotFeatureBuilder.ts:192), used only through the danger buckets (<=20 ft & <=35 deg high; <=40 ft & <=50 deg medium; else low); rebound flag (DEFAULT_REBOUND_WINDOW_SECONDS=3, web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlRebounds.ts:6); rush flag (DEFAULT_RUSH_WINDOW_SECONDS=10, web/lib/supabase/Upserts/nhlRush.ts:5); royal-road crossing (prior and current event y of opposite sign, both x>=25, nhlContextualFeatures.ts:277); goal outcome (as a floor). EXCLUDES: shot type, distance/angle as continuous terms (bucketed only), strength state, score state/score effects, shooter talent, goalie effects, venue/rink scorer bias adjustment, time/period, empty-net handling, training set or seasons (none — constants are hand-set), model type (none; lookup table, not logistic/GBM), calibration to league goal rate (none). Blocked attempts are not excluded in team summaries (attempt type not checked before assigning xG). A copy of the same proxy is in nhlNstParityMetrics.ts:~410 (other slice).
calculations.reference_standard: MoneyPuck / Evolving-Hockey / NST logistic xG models (outcome-blind, calibrated to league goal rate)
calculations.status: live — team_underlying_stats_summary written by pages/api/v1/db/update-player-underlying-stats.ts:242 and sweep-gamecenter-normalization.ts:352 (plus manual catch-up/backfill/rebuild routes); read by pages/api/v1/underlying-stats/teams.ts for /underlying-stats/teamStats; live — read by pages/api/v1/underlying-stats/players.ts and goalies.ts (+[playerId], chart) for /underlying-stats/playerStats and /goalieStats; summaries written by pages/api/v1/db/update-player-underlying-stats.ts, which runs from the lineCombinations insert trigger (supabase/migrations/20260716112910_harden_line_combination_trigger_auth.sql:130) and the pg_cron job 'update-player-underlying-stats-yesterday' at 09:35 UTC (tasks/TASKS/cron-operations/cron-schedule.md:382,827) (fallback ixG)

calculations.name: Legacy NHL statsapi TOI parsing, TOI% and PP-time share
calculations.purpose: Parse mm:ss TOI to minutes and (legacy) chart a player's per-game TOI% and share of team PP time.
calculations.method: parseTime: if string contains '.', return Number(string) unchanged; else minutes = mm + ss/60. TOI% per game = TOI minutes*100/60. Team PP time per date = (sum of every current-roster player's PPTOI minutes on that date)/5; player PP share = player PPTOI / team PP time * 100. Callers convert parseTime output to seconds with *60.

calculations.reference_standard: NHL.com TOI mm:ss; NST TOI convention (seconds or minutes) and PP share = player PP TOI / team PP TOI
calculations.input_units: 'mm:ss' strings -> MINUTES (parseTime); strings containing '.' passed through unchanged (assumed minutes); callers multiply by 60 to get SECONDS
calculations.output_scale: parseTime: decimal minutes; fetchTOIData TOI: percent of 60 minutes (0-100+, OT can exceed 100); PPTOI: percent 0-100 of estimated team PP time

calculations.name: Social share per-game series reconstruction from cumulative and window sums (sparklines)
calculations.purpose: Solve each of a skater's last 10 per-game values exactly from stored season-to-date totals and last-N window totals, then check them against the row's own L5.
calculations.method: Ranges: season totals (games 1..n, total = avg_season*GP; points must round to an integer within 0.01) plus writer windows (n-N+1..n). Nested ranges sharing a start or end are subtracted into new ranges (<= 12 rounds, <= 400 ranges); a range with one unknown game solves it; points ranges with total 0 set all games 0. Points series rejected unless sums of last 5/10 equal stored totals; TOI series rejected if |mean of last 5 - toi_avg_last5| > 2 s; rate series per game = count/TOI*3600 and rejected if pooled L5 rate differs from stored L5 by > max(2% of L5, 0.05).

calculations.name: Skater trend percentile series with low-sample shrink

calculations.name: Player trend page: rolling-vs-baseline delta %, hot/cold streak and L7/L14/L30 quick cards
calculations.purpose: Client-side comparison of a player's rolling window value against a chosen baseline, streak labelling, and calendar-day recent averages on /trends/player/[playerId].
calculations.method: absolute = rolling - baseline; delta% = (rolling - baseline)/|baseline|*100 (null when baseline 0). Streak: latest delta >= +8 -> hot, <= -8 -> cold, else steady; streak length = consecutive most-recent games with delta >= 0 (hot) or <= 0 (cold), a sign test rather than the 8% threshold; averageDelta = mean of all deltas; metrics sorted by |latestDelta|. Quick cards: Rolling10 uses the last10 field; L7/L14/L30 = unweighted mean of raw per-game values with game_date in [latest-(days-1), latest] (calendar days anchored to the player's last game, not today), then delta% vs baseline. Metric families: additive_average (goals, assists, points, shots, hits, blocks, pp_points) and weighted_rate per-60 metrics.
consumers: /trends/player/[playerId] page (chart, streak chips 'N straight games above baseline', quick comparison cards)
calculations.input_units: per-game counts (additive_average) and per-60 rates (weighted_rate); TOI-average metrics in seconds
calculations.output_scale: delta in percent (unbounded, signed); streak length in games; recent value in source metric units

calculations.name: Legacy sKO characteristic-game classifier (z-scores, weighted chi-square thresholds, stat weights)
calculations.sub_family: Rolling player averages & trends / legacy sKO
calculations.purpose: Label each game as Highly/Moderately/Uncharacteristic versus the player's prior games.
inputs: shooting_percentage, ipp, on_ice_shooting_pct, zone_start_pct, time_on_ice, pa_to_sa_ratio, sog_per_60, pp_toi_pct_per_game
calculations.method: Weights = normalized inverse of importance ratings (SH% 4.0625, IPP 4.8125, oiSH% 6.263, ZS% 6.583, TOI 4.692, PA/SA 6.571, SOG/60 4.0625, PPTOI% 4.667) -> sum to 1. For game i, baseline = mean and population SD (divide by n) over games 0..i-1; SD 0 -> 1. z capped at +/-5; per-stat label |z|<=1 Highly, <=2 Moderately, else Uncharacteristic. Score = sum w*z^2; T1 = sum w (=1), T2 = T1 + 2*sqrt(2*sum w^2) (chi-square-1 mean/variance approximation). PA/SA ratio: current game capped at 10 (SA=0 & PA>0 -> 10); prior games recomputed with Infinity for SA=0, then non-finite values filtered out of mean/SD. First game -> 'Insufficient History'.
calculations.reference_standard: Standard z-score / chi-square approximation; weighted sum of squared z assumes independent normals
calculations.input_units: per-game values: shooting_percentage, ipp, on_ice_shooting_pct, zone_start_pct (percent units undeclared), time_on_ice (units undeclared, WGO usually seconds), sog_per_60 (per-60), pp_toi_pct_per_game, PA/SA ratio
calculations.output_scale: z-scores capped +/-5; weighted sum of squared z (>=0); T1=1, T2=1+2*sqrt(2*sum w^2); categorical labels

inputs: count columns (GF, GA, W, L, OTL, pts, hits, PIM, PPG, PPO, ...)
source_tables: rolling_games (from NHL stats REST team summary/realtime/powerplay/penalties, isGame=true)
calculations.method: Ordered by game_date per team. STD: rate columns = simple mean of per-game values over games 1..i; counts = running sums. LTG: window games[max(0,i-9)..i] (last 10 games), same mean-of-rates and sums. Also date ranges and arrays of game ids/opponents/home_road.
outputs: std_* and ltg_* columns (rates averaged, counts summed)
calculations.reference_standard: Ratio-of-sums convention (e.g. PP% = PPG/PPO over window; SAT% = SATF/(SATF+SATA))
calculations.input_units: per-game NHL REST values: pct fields as returned (NHL stats REST uses 0-1 fractions), per-60s, per-game shots, TOI seconds
calculations.output_scale: means of per-game rates (mean-of-ratios) and summed counts

calculations.name: TOI resolution, trust tiers and WGO minutes/seconds normalization
calculations.purpose: Resolve per-game TOI seconds for each strength with source priority and sanity bounds.
inputs: WGO toi_per_game / es_toi_per_game / pp_toi / pp_toi_per_game / sh_toi_per_game / toi_per_game_5v5
calculations.method: Priority counts (authoritative) -> counts_oi (authoritative) -> rates toi_per_gp (supplementary) -> fallback seed (counts/counts_oi/WGO) -> WGO (fallback). Rejected if non-finite, <0 (or 0 for all strength; 0 allowed for split strengths) or >= 4000 s. WGO all-strength value > 200 is treated as seconds, otherwise minutes*60 (rounded); split-strength WGO fields are always treated as seconds.
calculations.reference_standard: NST TOI in seconds; NHL API timeOnIce seconds
calculations.input_units: NST toi and toi_per_gp in seconds; WGO all-strength toi_per_game seconds or minutes (guessed: >200 = seconds); WGO strength-specific fields treated as seconds
calculations.output_scale: TOI seconds per game, valid range (0 or >0) to <4000 s

calculations.name: Ratio-of-sums rolling/historical aggregation engine
calculations.purpose: Shared accumulator that computes every ratio and per-60 metric from summed numerator/denominator components over last-N, all-processed, season, 3-year and career scopes.
calculations.method: Value = (sum num / sum den) * scale, optionally + (sum num2 / sum den2) * scale ('sum' combine, used by PDO), then * outputScale, rounded to 6 dp. Never averages per-game ratios. Windows 3/5/10/20 (CANONICAL_ROLLING_GAME_WINDOWS) are FIFO queues of the last N slots. For ratio_performance and weighted_rate_performance families the window mode is 'appearance': a slot is consumed only when anchor=true (all-strength: every WGO row; split strengths: TOI>0), and a slot with missing/invalid components still occupies the slot but adds nothing. A missing numerator beside a present denominator drops the components (explicit 0 still counts). No denominator -> null or 0 per spec. Historical buckets are keyed by season and are NOT anchor-gated; 3YA = seasons with startYear in [current-2, current]; career = every season bucket read.
calculations.reference_standard: Ratio-of-sums convention (NST/Evolving-Hockey aggregate rates as sum(events)/sum(TOI)); last-N-games windows
calculations.input_units: raw component totals (counts, TOI seconds, on-ice counts); season ids like 20242025
calculations.output_scale: depends on spec: scale 3600 -> per-60 rate; scale 100 -> percent 0-100; scale 1 -> fraction 0-1; PDO sum*0.01 -> index ~1.0 (0-2). Ratio of sums, never mean of ratios; rounded 6 dp

calculations.name: Rolling window contracts and metric-to-family map
calculations.purpose: Declares what 'last N' means and which aggregation each metric family uses.
calculations.method: Four families: availability (current team's last N chronological team games), additive_performance (sum and mean over the player's last N appearances with a defined value), ratio_performance (ratio of aggregated components over last N appearances in the strength state), weighted_rate_performance (sum events / sum TOI over last N appearances). Windows fixed at 3, 5, 10, 20. Mapping: per-60s -> weighted_rate; shooting_pct, primary_points_pct, expected_sh_pct, ipp, oz_start_pct, pp_share_pct, on_ice_sh_pct, pdo, cf_pct, ff_pct -> ratio; counts, ixg, iscf, ihdcf, toi_seconds, pp_toi_seconds -> additive.

calculations.name: NST goalie catch-up step planner (windows, budgets, burst sizing)
calculations.purpose: Plan bounded daily NST goalie dataset catch-up: which date/dataset units to fetch, when, with what spacing and attempt cap.

Daily caps: MAX_STEPS 7, MAX_ATTEMPTS 60; cooldown 600 s after the last direct NST job; operating windows 08:30-08:35 and 11:10-12:50 UTC and a step (220 s) must fit inside the window. Burst iff 0 < plannedRequestCount < 40 -> up to 20 units at 0 ms spacing, else 6 units at 21,000 ms; maxAttempts = min(units*3, 60 - attemptsUsed); deadline = now + 220 s.

calculations.name: NST goalie freshness assessment (coverage counts and status tiers)
calculations.purpose: Compare expected WGO goalie appearances to NST goalie rows over the last 14 days and classify freshness healthy/warning/critical.
calculations.method: cutoff = min(yesterday ET, regularSeasonEnd); window = [max(seasonStart, cutoff-13 days), cutoff]. A game is matched when an NST row exists with non-null hdShotsAgainst (>=0). expected = count, matched = expected - missing, per-date expected/matched, oldestGap = earliest missing date, latestCompleteDate = last date with expected==matched. Status: before 13:00 UTC with gaps -> not_due; else gaps -> critical if (cutoff - oldestGap) >= 2 days or noProgressWindows >= 2, otherwise warning; no gaps -> healthy; any incomplete enumeration -> unknown.

calculations.output_scale: status enum healthy|warning|critical|unknown|not_due; integer counts expected/matched

calculations.name: Goalie parity counts, SV%, GAA and 'GSAA'
calculations.purpose: Compute goalie shots against, saves, GA, SV%, GAA, xGA, GSAA, HD/MD/LD SV% and GAA, rush/rebound attempts against, average shot/goal distance.
calculations.method: Goalie team = team opposite event owner. SA/saves from goal+SOG excluding own goals; GA counts all goals incl. own goals. SV% = saves/SA*100. GAA = GA*3600/TOI. xg_against = sum of approximate xG for all non-own-goal attempts. gsaa = xg_against - GA. HD SV% = hd_saves/hd_SA*100; hd_gaa = (hd_SA - hd_saves)*3600/TOI; md/ld analogous; hd/md/ld_gsaa hard-coded null. avg distances = mean shot/goal distance in feet. Per-60 versions via toPer60 including gsaa_per_60. XG INCLUDES (fallback heuristic): shot x,y mirrored to attacking direction by event-owner side and homeTeamDefendingSide, net at (89,0) ft; distance (ft) and angle (deg, |dy|/|89-x|) only via danger bucket cut-offs (<=20ft&<=35deg high, <=40ft&<=50deg medium); rebound flag (3 s, same team, immediate prior SOG/miss/block); rush flag (10 s backward scan, D/N-zone takeaway/faceoff win/opp giveaway/opp block); royal-road flag; goal outcome floor 0.25. XG EXCLUDES: shot type, strength state, score state, empty-net adjustment, shooter effects, goalie effects, any trained model or training set/seasons (hand-set constants), calibration (excluded). The trained model (scripts/train-nhl-xg-baseline.ts) is NOT wired into this path in production.
consumers: underlying stats goalie views via playerStatsLandingServer.ts
calculations.reference_standard: NST goalie: GSAA = SA x league-average SV% - GA; GSAx = xGA - GA; SV% 0-100 on NST
calculations.input_units: shot counts; TOI seconds; distance feet; xG in goals
calculations.output_scale: SV% percent 0-100; GAA per 60 (per 3600 s); gsaa in goals (xGA-GA); avg distance feet

calculations.name: Zone starts and zone faceoff shares
calculations.purpose: Count O/N/D zone starts and on-ice zone faceoffs and compute OZS% and OZFO%.
calculations.method: Zone code made team-relative (owner keeps code, opponent inverted O<->D). A faceoff is a zone start if the previous event is stoppage/period-start/goal/penalty/delayed-penalty; zone-start credit goes only to on-ice players whose shift started at that exact period second. All on-ice players get zone faceoff counts. OZS% = OZ/(OZ+NZ+DZ)*100; OZFO% = OZFO/(all FO)*100.
calculations.reference_standard: NST zone starts (shifts starting with a faceoff; OZS% often reported excluding neutral zone)
calculations.output_scale: counts; OZS% and OZFO% percent 0-100 (NZ in denominator)

calculations.name: Approximate xG fallback heuristic
calculations.purpose: Assign an xG value per shot attempt when no model xG is attached.
calculations.method: Base 0.18 high / 0.08 medium / 0.02 low; +0.03 rebound, +0.02 rush, +0.02 royal-road; if the shot is a goal, value = max(value, 0.25); cap 0.95. Applied to every shot attempt type including blocked and missed. XG INCLUDES (fallback heuristic): shot x,y mirrored to attacking direction by event-owner side and homeTeamDefendingSide, net at (89,0) ft; distance (ft) and angle (deg, |dy|/|89-x|) only via danger bucket cut-offs (<=20ft&<=35deg high, <=40ft&<=50deg medium); rebound flag (3 s, same team, immediate prior SOG/miss/block); rush flag (10 s backward scan, D/N-zone takeaway/faceoff win/opp giveaway/opp block); royal-road flag; goal outcome floor 0.25. XG EXCLUDES: shot type, strength state, score state, empty-net adjustment, shooter effects, goalie effects, any trained model or training set/seasons (hand-set constants), calibration (excluded). The trained model (scripts/train-nhl-xg-baseline.ts) is NOT wired into this path in production.
outputs: xG per attempt -> ixg, xgf, xga, goalie xg_against, gsaa
consumers: ixG, xGF, xGA, xGF%, goalie xG against / 'gsaa' in buildNstParityMetrics
calculations.reference_standard: Evolving-Hockey / MoneyPuck / NST xG (Fenwick-based logistic models; outcome never an input)
calculations.output_scale: xG per attempt, probability-like 0.02-0.95 (summed to xGF/xGA in goals)

calculations.name: NST rate-limit admission window math (local ledger + shared RPC + Python admission)
calculations.purpose: Decide when the next NST request may start so the rolling 1m/5m/15m/1h windows and 21 s spacing are never exceeded across callers.
where: web/lib/nst/requestBudget.ts:107 (1h ledger prune + window wait loop to :120)
web/lib/nst/client.ts:281 (admission deadline = run deadline - timeout - 5 s)
inputs: request URL (key param stripped, sorted, sha256)
calculations.method: Windows: 1m max 39, 5m max 80, 15m max 100, 1h max 180; min spacing 21,000 ms. Local ledger: drop inactive attempts older than 1 h; wait = max(100 ms if same URL in flight, last.startedAt + max(last.intervalMs, intervalMs) - now, for each window with count>=max: the (count-max)-th oldest startedAt + windowMs + 1 - now). Interval = 0 only when minIntervalMs==0 AND plannedRequestCount is a safe integer 1..78 (semi-burst, 'two 39-attempt waves'); else max(21000, minIntervalMs). Every network attempt (incl. retries) counts. Shared RPC: POST with p_burst/p_planned_requests; if allowed, permit must be used within permitTtlMs=1000 ms measured from before the POST; if denied sleep max(25 ms, waitMs). Python mirror: same receipt checks, burst iff min_interval_ms==0 and 1<=planned_requests<=78, default min_interval_ms 21000, default deadline now+220 s, sleep max(0.025 s, waitMs/1000). Static plan check: projected requests in a window at fixed cadence = min(n, floor(window/interval)+1).
tables_written: shared admission ledger via RPC (server-side SQL, not in this slice)
consumers: functions/api/fetch_team_table.py and other Python NST callers
calculations.reference_standard: Repository NST policy (AGENTS.md / memory): 40/1m, 80/5m, 100/15m, 180/h unique URLs, 21 s spacing, only jobs <40 requests may burst
calculations.input_units: milliseconds (TS: windowMs, intervalMs, waitMs, Date.now epoch ms); seconds (Python: time.monotonic, waitMs/1000); request counts per rolling window
calculations.output_scale: wait time in ms (>=0) or permit/deny; ledger counts per window 0..39/80/100/180

calculations.name: Shift interval normalization, stints and stint lookup
calculations.purpose: Clean NHL shift rows into intervals, dedupe, build constant-personnel stints and find on-ice players at an event second.
calculations.method: If end<=start or null, end = start + duration; drop non-positive durations. Dedupe on game/player/team/period/start/end keeping lowest shift_id. Stints: split each period at every shift start/end boundary, players active if interval overlaps [start,end); merge adjacent identical personnel. Lookup at second s: candidates with start<=s<=end; prefer the stint ENDING at s, else start<=s<end.
calculations.reference_standard: NST shift-change convention (events at a change second credited to outgoing players except faceoffs credited to incoming)

calculations.name: WiGO player ratings (offense/defense/overall by strength)
calculations.purpose: Weighted composite of stat percentiles per strength (AS/ES/PP/PK) into 0-100 offense, defense and overall ratings.

calculations.method: Per stat percentile (x100) vs cohort with gp >= cohortMinGp; withheld if < 20 peers (WIGO_RATING_MIN_COHORT_PEERS). If player GP < 10 at that strength: regressed = (GP*pct + (10-GP)*mean pct of peers with GP>=10)/10, clamped 0-100. Offense weights AS/ES: P/60 25, ixG/60 20, SOG/60 15, iSCF/60 10, iHDCF/60 10, xGF% 10, CF% 5, PEND/60 5; defense AS/ES: xGA/60 30, SCA/60 20, HDCA/60 15, BLK/60 10, TK/60 10, minor pen/60 5, GV/60 10 (lower better where noted); PP offense: GF/60 25, xGF/60 20, P/60 15, SCF/60 10, SOG/60 15, HDGF/60 10, PEND/60 5; PK defense: GA/60 25, xGA/60 20, SCA/60 15, SA/60 10, HDCA/60 10, BLK/60 10, TK/60 5. Rating = weighted mean of available percentiles. overall.as/es = mean(off,def); overall.st = PP-off and PK-def weighted by PP/PK TOI; final = mean(as, es, st).
calculations.reference_standard: Percentile composite ratings (e.g. Evolving-Hockey RAPM/GAR as stronger alternative); Tango regression to the mean

calculations.name: FORGE starter probability model (computeStarterProbabilities)
calculations.sub_family: Goalie starters & starter odds / starter odds
calculations.purpose: Score each candidate goalie and convert to start probabilities (sigmoid for 2, softmax for 3).
inputs: L10 starts by goalie (forge_goalie_game, starter = max TOI per date)
calculations.method: score = 2.4*(L10share-0.5) + 0.7*logit(prior clamp .01-.99) + 0.45*logit(lineCombo prior clamp .05-.95) + 0.5*clamp(GSAA60,+-0.6) + 0.28*(seasonStart%-0.5)*GP/(GP+10) + 0.2*GP/(GP+10); B2B: starter of previous game -2.75, other goalie +0.65; B2B & team weaker (GF + 0.35 < opp GF): primary (L10share>=0.6) -1.1, backup +0.45; weak opponent (GF <= 2.6): primary -0.7, backup +0.3; rust: >75 d -6, >30 d -3, >14 d -0.8, <=7 d +0.2. Two candidates: p = clamp(sigmoid(diff), .02, .98); three: softmax clamped .01-.98 (not renormalized). One candidate -> 1.
consumers: FORGE goalie stage -> starter board / start chart (serving flag)
calculations.reference_standard: Goalie usage studies (B2B starter rates ~10-20% for repeat starter); Daily Faceoff confirmations; logistic starter models

calculations.name: Community draft rankings: regularized Bradley-Terry with ADP prior
calculations.purpose: Aggregate users' pairwise preferences into a public community top-250.
inputs: pair preferences (latest per user+pair, consent/moderation filtered)
candidates with marketRank = prior-season Yahoo preseason_average_pick (fallback average_draft_pick, min across mapped keys)
calculations.method: Scores s_i, prior mean m_i = ln((F+1-r)/r) for market rank r (F = field size), 0 if unranked. Market prior weight = 4*max(0, 1-independentUsers/20). Objective: Bradley-Terry log-likelihood with P(i beats j)=sigmoid(s_i-s_j) - 0.25/2*s^2 (L2) - w_i/2*(s_i-m_i)^2. Diagonal (Jacobi) Newton: delta = clamp(0.5*grad/curvature, +/-1), up to 500 iters, tol 1e-8; must converge. Evidence states: emerging (>=5 users, >=10 comparisons, >=5 opponents), established (>=20 users, >=40 comparisons, >=10 opponents, >=2 opponents ranked 200-250 and >=2 ranked 251-300). stabilityBuffer = ceil(30/sqrt(users)+40/sqrt(comparisons)+10/sqrt(opponents)) (75 with no comparisons); conservativeRank = modelRank + buffer. Public top-250: market rank <=250 and not established (market prior), OR established and conservativeRank <= 250; renumbered 1..250 by model rank. rank_delta = previousPublicRank - publicRank.
calculations.reference_standard: Bradley-Terry / Elo-style paired comparison models with Gaussian prior (e.g. Glicko/TrueSkill shrinkage); Hunter MM algorithm
calculations.output_scale: latent score (log-odds scale); ranks 1..N; public rank 1..250

Ownership riser: latest vs point ~7 days earlier (gap 6-10 days, latest <=2 days old in season / 7 offseason); qualifies if delta >= 5 pp or >= top-decile (ceil(0.9n)-th) of positive deltas. Opportunity: verified event types with confidence >= 0.75 and unexpired, or team change; deployment share gain >= 0.15; score = max(rankGain, shareGain*100). Owner-relative: personalRank - consensusRank >= 25 -> cutoff_challenger if personal rank 251-275 else projection_gap.

calculations.name: Draft Ranker assisted placement: binary-search rank interval engine
calculations.purpose: Place a new player in a personal ranking with pairwise questions.
calculations.method: Initial interval by bucket (top_50 [1,50], 51-100, ..., outside_250 [251,N+1], unsure [1,N+1]). Ask the anchor nearest the interval midpoint; target_over_anchor -> high=min(high, rank); anchor_over_target -> low=max(low, rank+1); too_close -> [rank, rank+1]. When width<=1, validate ranks suggested-1, suggested and 250/251 cutoff; contradiction -> one retry then finish broadened. suggestedRank = floor((low+high)/2); plausible width +/-4 (<=100), 7 (<=200), 10 otherwise when broadened; confidence developing if contradictions, strong if >=5 questions else moderate. Cap 12 questions (16 with contradictions).
calculations.reference_standard: Binary insertion sort / noisy binary search

calculations.name: aggregateTeamCategoryTotals / rankTeamCategories / categoryRankBand
calculations.purpose: Team category totals without averaging rates, and per-category standings ranks.
calculations.method: Counting categories: sum. Rates exact from summed parts when all inputs present: SV% = sum saves/sum SA (SA = SAVES+GA fallback); GAA = sum GA/sum TOTAL_TOI*3600; S% = G/SOG; FO% = FOW/(FOW+FOL); TOI/G = sum TOTAL_TOI/sum GP. Otherwise 'estimated' workload-weighted mean of the rate (SV% by SA; GAA by starts then appearances; S% by SOG; FO% by attempts; TOI by GP); any invalid input -> unavailable. Ranks: competition ranking (ties share rank) ascending/descending by higherIsBetter (points league negative weights invert). Band: percentile=(N-rank+1)/N*100: <=25 red, <=50 orange, <=75 yellow, else green.
calculations.reference_standard: Roto/H2H category standings conventions
calculations.output_scale: totals; SV% fraction; GAA goals/60; rank 1..N

Mock: seat = ((pick-1)/count odd) ? count-offset-1 : offset (snake only). Roster progress fraction = min(1, filled/capacity).

calculations.name: buildPositionTiers / advisePosition: 1-D k-means positional tiers + take-now advice
calculations.purpose: Automatic value tiers per position and Take now / Can wait advice.
source_tables: projection source tables configured in lib/projectionsConfig/projectionSourcesConfig.ts (e.g. projections_* per source)
calculations.method: Values min-max scaled to 0..1; exact contiguous 1-D k-means (DP on prefix sums), k=2..min(8,unique,n-1), best k by mean silhouette (neighbour-group 1-D silhouette); n<4 -> one band. Then recursively split any band wider than 0.05 of the scaled range at its min-SSE boundary. Tied values never split. breakThreshold = max(3*median adjacent gap, 0.25*IQR). Remaining band gap = last remaining in band minus first remaining in next non-empty band; meaningfulBreak if gap > breakThreshold. Advice: expected = sum availability over remaining band players; 'Can wait' if opposingPicks=0 or expected>=1.5 (and gap known); 'Take now' if expected<0.5 and meaningfulBreak. Tier adapter nulls values whose required inputs (SV% needs SA>0, GAA needs starts) are incomplete.
calculations.reference_standard: Jenks natural breaks / 1-D k-means tiering (e.g. Boris Chen Gaussian-mixture tiers)
calculations.input_units: fantasy points or z-score sum; ADP pick numbers
