calculations.name: Mock draft bot pick model (decide): utility score + softmax sampling
calculations.purpose: Simulate opponent picks in mock drafts with personalities.
inputs: session players {value, adp, positions, categories, workload}
calculations.method: range = max(1, top value - value at rank teamCount*3). score = (v - top)/range + 0.15*(v - baseline_pos)/range [baseline = value at index roster_pos*teamCount-1 in full pool] - max(0, ADP - pick)/(teamCount*(Vanilla?1:4)) + (needed ? (Conservative 0.65 : 0.28) : -0.25) - 0.25*max(0, heldAtPos - slots). Pro: + scarcity*0.22*min(2, planningWait/teamCount) where scarcity = max(0, v - replacement_value)/range and replacement = available player at index round(demand) (demand = sum over opponents picking before my next turn of 1 if they still need the position else 0.25); + min(0.3, gap/range) if needed and a meaningful tier break is nearly exhausted; categories weakness bonus clamp(+/-0.2, 0.04*sum cat_k/(1+held_k)). Free: + min(0.15, 0.08*scarcity). Personalities: Zero-G -1.5*max(0,0.9-progress) for G; Fade -0.65*(1-progress) at position; Reach +0.5+0.3*scarcity; Hero-G +min(0.9, workload/70)*(games?0.6:1); BPA +0.4*(v-top)/range; Contrarian + (0.4*positive - 0.6 fade|0.3 bust)*confidence(1/0.7/0.4). Shortlist (6, Aggressive pro 10) from plausible (rank<2T or ADP<=pick+2T or needed&scarcity>0.2) that keep rosters completable (max-flow feasibility). Turn planning (pro, consecutive picks): +0.3*max(next best + 0.35 if fits open slot). Choice ~ softmax(score/temperature), temperature 0.08 (Vanilla/BPA) else 0.13 (+0.22 Aggressive) + 0.04*variation; seeded FNV/mulberry RNG.
tables_written: mock_draft_events (via mock_draft_ingest, only human picks contribute to ADP)
calculations.reference_standard: Opponent modelling in draft simulators (ADP-based pick probability / softmax over value)
calculations.input_units: value in FP or z units; ADP picks
calculations.output_scale: dimensionless score; pick probabilities via softmax
calculations.status: live — mock drafts (lib/mockDraft/flags.ts gates)

calculations.name: useVORPCalculations: VORP / VOLS / VONA / VBD per player
calculations.sub_family: Draft tools (ranker/dashboard/mock/ADP/VORP) | Draft tools / draft value (VORP/VONA/VBD)
calculations.purpose: Compute league-wide draft value over replacement (VORP), over last starter (VOLS), over next available (VONA) and the blended VBD rank value for every projected player.
source_tables: projection source tables configured in lib/projectionsConfig/projectionSourcesConfig.ts (e.g. projections_* per source)
calculations.method: (1) REPLACEMENT LEVEL: per roster position p (C/LW/RW/D/G, or FWD/D/G when grouped; +FWD pool when rosterConfig.FWD>0) with T=teamCount and starters s_p (minus my filled slots when personalizeReplacement): VORP index = floor(T*(s_p + utilAdj_p) + 1) - 1 = T*(s_p+utilAdj_p) (0-based, i.e. the first player beyond league starters); VOLS index = floor(T*s_p) - 1 (the last league starter). UTIL slots are split 1/3 each to C/LW/RW (UTIL_TO_DEF_ENABLED=false so D gets 0); in 'fwd' grouping UTIL goes wholly to FWD. Bench slots are NOT counted (not handled). Goalies get no UTIL share. Replacement pool = remaining (available) players by default or full pool when baselineMode='full'; index clamped to pool length-1; empty pool -> replacement 0. (2) VALUE SOURCE: buildPlayerValues -> points leagues: projected fantasy points (source-weighted projection x league scoring; optional 84-game proration for skaters); categories leagues: sum of weighted z-scores from calculateCategoryScores. Optional Draft Pro position weight multiplier (0..2) applied to the value before pools. (3) VONA: N = floor(picksUntilNext); take the N available players with lowest Yahoo ADP (players without ADP ignored); each contributes 1/k to each of its k eligible positions -> expectedTaken_p. Baseline = value at index floor(currentIndexOfPlayerInAvailablePool_p + expectedTaken_p) in that position's available pool (or index floor(expectedTaken_p) if the player is not in the pool); VONA = value - baseline. Assumes opponents draft strictly by ADP; ignores opponent roster needs. (4) VBD = 0.6*VORP + 0.3*VONA + 0.1*VOLS (dashboard-specific blend; classic VBD uses one baseline). (5) MULTI-POSITION: eligibility normalized (F/FWD -> C,LW,RW); a player appears in every eligible pool; reported metrics come from the eligible position with max VORP (ties broken by VONA then VOLS) - not summed. Positional scarcity enters only through per-position replacement depth.
consumers: ProjectionsTable, SuggestedPicks, MyRoster, DraftBoard, LeagueStandings, DraftSummaryModal
calculations.reference_standard: Classic VBD (Joe Bryant, footballguys 'Value Based Drafting': value minus baseline player at position); VORP (Baseball Prospectus-style value over replacement, replacement = first non-starter at T*starters+1); VONA (Value Over Next Available, e.g. Draft Buddy/Fantasy Football Calculator: best at position now minus best expected at your next pick); VOLS (value over last starter, baseline = T*starters-th player); Man-games baseline (Lammey/Dodds 100/120-pick baseline) as alternative
calculations.input_units: value: fantasy points (season totals; 84-game pace if prorate84) or dimensionless z-score sum; picksUntilNext in picks; ADP in overall pick number
calculations.output_scale: VORP/VOLS/VONA/VBD in same units as value (fantasy points or z-score sum), unbounded, can be negative
calculations.status: live — used by DraftDashboard (pages/draft-dashboard) for every table/recommendation

calculations.name: buildPersonalizedRecommendations (Draft Pro): need-weighted recommendation score
calculations.sub_family: Draft tools (ranker/dashboard/mock/ADP/VORP) | Draft tools / draft value (VORP/VONA/VBD)
calculations.purpose: Personalize suggestion order by roster and category needs without changing league VORP.
inputs: candidates {globalVorp, rankValue, baselineScore, categoryValues, adp, eligiblePositions}
calculations.method: (1) Replacement: not recomputed (uses candidate.rankValue/baselineScore). (2) Value source: rankScore = baselineScore ?? rankValue. Category values recomputed: SV% = saves/(saves+GA or SA), GAA = GA*3600/TOTAL_TOI (TOI in seconds); per-category z-scores via calculateCategoryScores over the CANDIDATE pool. (3) No VONA logic here; availability = estimatePlayerAvailability (reason tag only, not in score). (4) Position fit = max(clamp01(need_p)) over eligible positions. Category fit = sum(z_k * need_k)/sum(|need_k|*|w_k|) over enabled role-applicable categories; categories add position fit. normalizedFit = clamp01(fit / max(1, max|fit|)). recommendationScore = rankScore + alpha * normalizedFit * adjustmentScale, adjustmentScale = max(1, max |rankScore| over all candidates). (5) Multi-position: best eligible position need.
outputs: RecommendationResult {rankScore, recommendationScore, globalVorp, availabilityEstimate, reasons, missingCategories}
calculations.reference_standard: Classic VBD (Joe Bryant, footballguys 'Value Based Drafting': value minus baseline player at position); VORP (Baseball Prospectus-style value over replacement, replacement = first non-starter at T*starters+1); VONA (Value Over Next Available, e.g. Draft Buddy/Fantasy Football Calculator: best at position now minus best expected at your next pick); VOLS (value over last starter, baseline = T*starters-th player); Man-games baseline (Lammey/Dodds 100/120-pick baseline) as alternative; SGP-based category need weighting

calculations.name: estimatePlayerAvailability: ADP normal-survival availability probability
calculations.sub_family: Draft tools (ranker/dashboard/mock/ADP/VORP) | Draft tools / draft value (VORP/VONA/VBD)
calculations.purpose: Probability a player is still available at the user's target pick, conditional on being available now.
inputs: spread (default 12, clamped 2..40; ProjectionsTable passes riskSd setting)
calculations.method: Player draft slot ~ Normal(ADP, sd). now = (currentPick-1-ADP)/sd; later = (currentPick-1+opposingPicks-ADP)/sd. P = S(later)/S(now) with S = upper-tail normal survival via Abramowitz-Stegun 26.2.17 polynomial in log space (constants 0.2316419, 0.31938153, -0.356563782, 1.781477937, -1.821255978, 1.330274429). opposingPicks=0 -> 1. Clamped 0..1.
calculations.reference_standard: ADP-normal availability models (e.g. FantasyPros 'chance available'); ADP SD typically scales with ADP
calculations.input_units: ADP and picks in overall pick numbers; spread in picks
calculations.status: live

observation, not audited: no calibration against real draft outcomes (code comment says heuristic)

calculations.purpose: Shared per-player comparable value and grouped eligibility feeding VORP, tiers and mock drafts.
source_tables: projection source tables configured in lib/projectionsConfig/projectionSourcesConfig.ts (e.g. projections_* per source)
calculations.method: Points: value = projected FP; if prorate84 and not goalie -> computeProratedFantasyPoints (counting stats / projected GP * 84) with league scoring only (mergeWithDefaults=false). Categories: build per-player projected map, derive SHOTS_AGAINST_GOALIE = SAVES+GA when missing and GAMES_STARTED from first of STARTS_GOALIE/GAMES_STARTED_GOALIE/GAMES_GOALIE/GAMES_PLAYED_GOALIE/GP_GOALIE, then calculateCategoryScores. Position weights: multiplier = max over player's eligible positions of weight (default 1), accepted only 0..2 and !=1; value *= multiplier after scoring; unweighted value kept. Eligibility: F/FWD expands to C,LW,RW; 'split' grouping keeps C/LW/RW and adds FWD if roster has a FWD slot; 'fwd' grouping collapses to FWD/D/G.
calculations.reference_standard: Classic VBD (Joe Bryant, footballguys 'Value Based Drafting': value minus baseline player at position); VORP (Baseball Prospectus-style value over replacement, replacement = first non-starter at T*starters+1); VONA (Value Over Next Available, e.g. Draft Buddy/Fantasy Football Calculator: best at position now minus best expected at your next pick); VOLS (value over last starter, baseline = T*starters-th player); Man-games baseline (Lammey/Dodds 100/120-pick baseline) as alternative
calculations.input_units: fantasy points totals or projected counting stats; weights fraction 0-2
calculations.status: live — via useVORPCalculations, tierDashboardAdapter, mockDraft adapter
red_flags: observation, not audited: GAMES_STARTED fallback uses GAMES_PLAYED_GOALIE (appearances) as starts - inflates GAA regression workload
observation, not audited: multiplier uses MAX across eligible positions, so a C/LW player gets the more favourable weight
observation, not audited: negative category composites scaled by weight<1 move toward zero (documented intentional in PRD)

calculations.name: computeProratedFantasyPoints / getProratedStat: 84-game skater pace
calculations.sub_family: Draft tools (ranker/dashboard/mock/ADP/VORP) | Draft tools / draft value (VORP/VONA/VBD)
calculations.purpose: Optionally pace skater counting projections to a full season before valuation.

FP = sum over scoring keys (HITS_D/BLOCKED_SHOTS_D position-specific values via pointValueForPlayerStat) of prorated*weight. Goalies, +/-, TOI and rate stats never prorated.
calculations.reference_standard: Full-season pace normalization (rate x games); compare with games-played risk adjustment conventions

calculations.name: calculateCategoryScores: weighted category z-score composite with goalie rate shrinkage
calculations.sub_family: Draft tools (ranker/dashboard/mock/ADP/VORP) | Draft tools / draft value (VORP/VONA/VBD)
calculations.purpose: Convert projected category stats to one comparable value for categories leagues.
inputs: categoryWeights (keys define enabled categories; default G,A,PPP,SOG,HIT,BLK)
calculations.method: Per role (skater/goalie) and category: mean and SAMPLE std dev (n-1) over every player in the supplied pool with a finite value. Goalie SV% shrunk: (SA*sv + 1200*mean)/(SA+1200) (PRIOR_SHOTS=1200); GAA shrunk: (GS*gaa + 25*mean)/(GS+25) (PRIOR_STARTS=25). z = (value-mean)/sd, inverted for GAA, GOALS_AGAINST_GOALIE, LOSSES_GOALIE. Score = sum weight_k * z_k (weight defaults to 1 if non-finite). GAMES_PLAYED and TOTAL_TOI apply to both roles. Categories with sd=0 or missing values contribute 0.
calculations.reference_standard: Standard z-score category valuation (e.g. Razzball/FanGraphs z-score method); SGP (standings gain points) as alternative; Tango-style regression to mean for rate stats
calculations.input_units: projected season totals; SV% fraction 0-1; GAA goals/60
calculations.status: live — categories leagues in Draft Dashboard, Draft Pro recommendations, mock drafts
red_flags: observation, not audited: mean/sd computed over the ENTIRE projection pool, not the draftable top-N (standard z-score methods recompute on the replacement-level pool) - deep pools compress top-player z gaps
observation, not audited: goalie rates are shrunk toward the mean AFTER mean/sd are computed from unshrunk values, so shrunk rates' z-scores are understated
observation, not audited: rate categories (SV%, GAA) are not volume-weighted beyond shrinkage; a 10-start goalie with elite SV% scores close to a 60-start goalie
observation, not audited: PRIOR_SHOTS=1200, PRIOR_STARTS=25 magic constants
observation, not audited: skater rate categories (e.g. SHOOTING_PERCENTAGE, FACEOFF_PERCENTAGE) get no shrinkage

calculations.name: Mock draft roster feasibility (Dinic max-flow)
calculations.purpose: Check that every team can still fill all roster slots from held plus remaining players, so the bot or user pick never makes the draft infeasible.
where: web/lib/mockDraft/engine.ts:353 (feasibility may force pick outside reach window)
source_tables: in-memory MockSession (players frozen by mockDraft/adapter freezePlayers)
calculations.method: Quick reject if held + available < teamCount × slots. Flow network: source → player groups (key = seat + sorted positions, capacity = group count) → (seat, slot type) nodes (capacity = slot count) → sink. Held groups connect only to their own seat; free players (seat −1) connect to any seat. Dinic max-flow (BFS levels plus DFS augment). Held players must all route (flow = held count); then free players are added to the residual graph and total flow must equal teamCount × slots.
consumers: mock draft engine decide()/canComplete (bot picks and user pick validation)
calculations.reference_standard: Bipartite matching / max-flow (Dinic)
calculations.status: live — mock drafts (lib/mockDraft/flags.ts gates)
red_flags: observation, not audited: grouping by sorted positions assumes fits() depends only on positions; any fits rule using other player fields (e.g. goalie flags) would be wrong for grouped players

calculations.name: Generic projection math primitives (decayBlend, ewsd, slope, shrinkage, poissonMeanFromRate, selectCountDistribution, clip, goalieFinishMult)
calculations.purpose: Reusable EWMA/shrinkage/Poisson-NB/clip helpers for projections.
calculations.method: decayBlend: weights exp(-daysAgo/tau) x optional multiplier; mean = sum(w v)/sum w; nEff = (sum w)^2/sum w^2. ewsd: weighted population SD. slope: OLS slope vs observation index. shrinkage: nEff/(nEff+k)*recent + k/(nEff+k)*prior. poissonMean = rate/60 * TOI minutes * multiplier. selectCountDistribution: NB if Fano = var/mean > 1.25 with r = mean^2/(var-mean), else Poisson. goalieFinishMult = clip(1 - (svProj - leagueSv)/0.070, 0.80, 1.20).
consumers: no TypeScript callers found outside tests (rg on each function name)
calculations.reference_standard: Tango regression to the mean (k = sample at r=0.5); Poisson/negative-binomial count models
calculations.input_units: days; per-60 rate with TOI in MINUTES (poissonMeanFromRate) — differs from rankings code which uses seconds
calculations.status: legacy/dead — only web/lib/math/utils.test.ts references
red_flags: observation, not audited: legacy/dead — no non-test imports of lib/math/utils found
observation, not audited: goalieFinishMult constant 0.070 SV% span and 0.8-1.2 clamp are magic numbers

calculations.name: WiGO player ratings (regressed percentile composite by strength)
calculations.purpose: Offense/defense/overall ratings per strength (AS/ES/PP/PK) from weighted, GP-regressed stat percentiles.
calculations.method: Per stat: mid-rank percentile among cohort with gp>=cohortMinGp (needs >= minCohortPeers peers). If player GP < 10 at that strength: regressed = (GP*pct + (10-GP)*mean pct of >=10-GP players)/10, clamp 0-100. Offense/defense = weighted mean of available stat percentiles (AS/ES offense: P/60 25, ixG/60 20, SOG/60 15, iSCF/60 10, iHDCF/60 10, xGF% 10, CF% 5, PenD/60 5; defense: xGA/60 30, SCA/60 20, HDCA/60 15, blocks 10, TK 10, minors 5, GV 10; PP and PK sets differ). overall.as/es = mean(off, def); ST = PP-offense and PK-defense weighted by PP/PK TOI share; final = mean(as, es, st).

calculations.name: NST career / 3-year averages (counts and rates) with multi-team TOT rows
calculations.purpose: Three-year and career averages of NST individual + on-ice stats.

source_tables: Natural Stat Trick HTML (via lib/nst/client cache)
calculations.method: parseTime: TOI float minutes -> seconds. Multi-team seasons: sum aggregateKeys into TOT then recompute derived. Seasons = last 3 excluding current (3-year; error if <3) or all (career); counts summed and divided by 3 or N seasons; derived recomputed from averaged counts. Rates TOT: per-60 values SUMMED across teams then (sum / TOI_seconds)*3600; rate averages = simple mean of season per-60 values (divisor 3 or N); percentages from averaged rates.

calculations.name: BSH board, Nightly Floor, Role Watch, What Changed, Last Night's Standouts: window vs baseline deltas

inputs: skater appearances (WGO) and NST game rows joined on player+date
calculations.method: BSH = blocks+shots+hits totals and per game; bar shares = component/sum. Range min GP = min(5, max(1, ceil(mostGames/2))). Nightly floor: share of appearances meeting a threshold (whole-number thresholds as X+1), admitted if known >= minCoverage%. Role Watch: mean TOI/PP TOI seconds per appearance recent vs baseline; qualifies if |change| >= minimum. What Changed: per-60 = value/TOI_seconds*3600, xGF% pooled; NST admitted if observed*100 >= minCoverage*expected. Standouts: % change = (last - baseline)*100/baseline; Avg = mean of changes capped +/-200% across stats whose baseline >= floors (SOG 0.75, TOI 600 s, iCF 2, iSCF 0.75, xG 0.05, xG% 35, PPTOI 30 s), needing >= 4 stats.

calculations.name: Goalie share cards: GSAx, Crease Shift, Busy/Quiet, Rescue, Ratio Impact, Category Counts, Goalie Period ADP, Risky Starts
calculations.purpose: Goalie workload/performance metrics for share cards.

WGO goalie games (starts, saves, SA, GA, TOI s)
calculations.method: GSAx = sum xGA - sum GA over covered window games (NST toi minutes*60 -> seconds); magnitude per 60 = |GSAx|/TOI*3600; admitted if appearances >= min and coverage% >= min. Crease share = starts/completed team games; change pp = (s*Bg - Bs*g)*100/(g*Bg). Busy/Quiet: workload per start/appearance/per 60. Rescue colour goodness = (v-min)/(max-min) (inverted for GAA). Ratio impact: pooled SV% = sum saves/sum SA, GAA = sum GA*3600/sum TOI s. Category Counts: count baseline = sum/known members, rates pooled, half-up integer rounding. Period ADP: mean Yahoo average pick; undrafted = ceil(max pick/10)*10. Risky starts: top/bottom-third flags (opp SF/GP & team SA/GP, xGF/xGA, SCF/SCA, PP% vs PK%, GF/GA, GD/GP); likely starter = most starts in last 10.

calculations.name: Social share L5 player score: L5 fantasy points per game x opportunity multiplier
calculations.purpose: Rank players on share cards (pickups, specialists, tiers).
inputs: recent L5 goals, assists, ppPoints, shots, hits/blocks per game, goalie W/SV/GA/SO
calculations.method: FP/GP = (G*3 + A*2 + PPP*1 + SOG*0.2 + (HIT/GP*0.2 + BLK/GP*0.25)*games)/games; goalies (W*4 + SV*0.2 + GA*-1 + SO*3)/games. Multiplier = 1 + line bonus (L1 .15, L2 .10, L3 .05, P1 .10, P2 .05) + PP bonus (PP1 .10, PP2 .05) + clamp(+/-0.10, 0.02 per minute of L5 TOI vs 16:00 F / 20:00 D). Score = FP/GP * multiplier; season rate breaks ties.
